title: ANALISTA TRIBUTOS SR
description:
Job description

A hora de fazer parte de um time comprometido, acolhedor e que leva saúde para milhões de pessoas, é agora!

Estamos na busca de profissionais para compor a nossa equipe!

Se você é comprometido(a) e apaixonado(a) por novos desafios, aqui é o seu lugar!


Main responsibilities

  • Realizar a apuração, contabilização e conciliação do IRPJ/CSLL (Lucro Real) corrente e diferido sobre o resultado da Companhia;
  • Realizar a revisão fiscal de balanço e garantir a conformidade tributária.
  • Elaborar as guias dos impostos, submeter e acompanhar o pagamento;
  • Realizar a conciliação dos impostos a recuperar (saldo negativo e retidos) e atuar na utilização e atualização dos créditos;
  • Preparar as PER/DCOMP e prestar esclarecimentos quando necessário;
  • Elaborar as notas explicativas dos impostos para as Demonstrações Financeiras, incluindo a análise das alíquotas efetivas e das variações contábeis;
  • Realizar o preenchimento das obrigações acessórias ECF e a conciliação da Parte B do e-Lalur/e-Lacs, atentando-se ao cumprimento da legislação fiscal vigente;
  • Atender às auditorias interna e externa;
  • Apoiar as áreas internas em dúvidas e interpretações da legislação tributária;
  • Atuar na regularização de débitos que impactem a Certidão Negativa de Débitos Federais.

Requirements and skills

Obrigatório:

  • Graduação completa em Contabilidade ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em SAP;
  • Sólida experiência de atuação com tributos diretos e planejamento tributário;
  • Conhecimento da rotina tributária (apuração dos impostos e fechamento contábil);
  • Conhecimento em reestruturação societária, amortização de ágio e mais-valia, no contexto da Lei 12.973/2014;
  • Conhecimento em automatização, elaboração de relatórios, Power BI e legislações da ANS será um diferencial.

title: Página da Vaga | Assistente de Logística de Materiais | Macaé/RJ
description:
Job description

Nós somos amantes do oceano. Somos uma empresa brasileira que há 45 anos desenvolve soluções submarinas para o mercado de energia offshore, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos oceanos. E se você compartilha essa paixão pelo mar e também é comprometido com a proteção do meio ambiente e seus valiosos recursos, seu lugar é aqui na Oceânica! Venha fazer parte da nossa família!


Main responsibilities

  • Embarque e desembarque de materiais e pessoal;
  • Emissão de RT no SAP, de embarques e quaisquer movimentações de materiais, transbordo etc;
  • Saída de materiais através do botão compartilhado;
  • Negociação com os fiscais e Geplat das embarcações e unidades marítimas;
  • Intervenção junto aos controles de PLSVs e apoios marítimo e aéreo para programação das RTs;.
  • Controle das notas fiscais Oceânica e Petrobras;
  • Controle e liquidação de MPT notas fiscais Petrobras;
  • Apoio as emissões de notas Petrobras para setores conforme determinação da Petrobras;
  • Controle dos certificados de contentores Oceânica e Petrobras;
  • Controle dos lançamentos no Sispat, ASO e associações pertinentes;
  • Emissão e controle de FCDR para descarte dos resíduos do CRD, bem como acompanhamento dos descartes de efluentes sanitários, água oleosa e consumo de água potável;
  • Reservas aéreas e hospedagens para viagem dos colaboradores Oceânica e Petrobras;
  • Controle de entrega dos insumos e acompanhamento para recebimento no CRD de materiais para as intervenções;
  • Acompanhamento e logística de materiais referente as remessas das reservas e DSM, do CRD para outras bases da Petrobras bem como para o CRD;
  • Liberação de acesso de pessoal e solicitação de emissão de crachás para acesso ao Tecab e outras subáreas;
  • Arquivo dos manuais e databook de materiais Oceânica e Petrobras, ainda não digitalizados;
  • Interagir com a Petrobrás, com o objetivo de mobilizar e desmobilizar cargas e equipamentos, através de RTs marítimas, terrestres e aéreas;
  • Controlar a documentação referente às certificações dos equipamentos de movimentação de cargas, tais como: contêineres, lingadas, cintas e manilhas;
  • Controlar a documentação referente a manutenção dos equipamentos considerados críticos;
  • Articular junto à Oceânica sobre questões que envolvam logística;
  • Articular com as unidades operacionais da Petrobras em processos de movimentação de carga, equipamentos e pessoal para as unidades marítimas e terrestres da Petrobrás;
  • Realizar visitas técnicas aos portos e/ou aeroportos, a critério da Petrobrás, para resolver ou acompanhar determinada logística;
  • Cumprir a Política do Sistema de Gestão Oceânica, na qual cada indivíduo deve responsabilizar-se pelos aspectos de qualidade e segurança de suas atividades, assim como pela preservação do meio ambiente em que as realiza.

Requirements and skills

Mandatório

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Noções básicas de informática (Pacote Office).
  • Experiência prévia na área;

Desejável

  • Cursos básicos em logística ou áreas correlatas são desejáveis;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de controle de estoque e logística;
  • Habilidade para operar equipamentos de movimentação de carga.

Additional information

Condições de trabalho

  • Local de trabalho: Macaé - RJ;
  • Regime: Onshore;
  • Modalidade: 100% presencial;
  • Carga horária: 44h - 07h30 às 17h18, com 1 hora de almoço, de segunda a sexta-feira.

Benefícios

  • Transporte fretado;
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição;
  • Plano de saúde extensivo aos dependentes legais;
  • Plano odontológico extensivo aos dependentes legais;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Gympass;
  • Curso de Inglês.

description:
Sobre a Inventa

Estamos revolucionando a distribuição B2B no Brasil com nosso inovador modelo DaaS (Distribution as a Service), que combina inteligência artificial e excelência operacional. Com um foco absoluto no cliente, capacitamos as marcas a se tornarem suas próprias distribuidoras, otimizando custos e prazos operacionais de maneira eficaz. Como uma startup ágil e dinâmica, oferecemos uma plataforma que simplifica a conexão entre marcas e varejistas. Nossos Consultores Inventa atuam como verdadeiros parceiros estratégicos, impulsionando as vendas e maximizando resultados. Nossa missão é ser um aliado confiável e o canal principal de distribuição, transformando o B2B em um processo mais ágil e eficiente. Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa revolução que está moldando o futuro da distribuição no Brasil!

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web de alto desempenho, seguras e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para identificar e resolver problemas complexos de software.
  • Trabalhar com metodologias Ágeis e participar de cerimônias para contribuir com melhorias no processo da equipe.
  • Ser responsável por todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software: definição, desenvolvimento, testes, produção e manutenção.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas da equipe, reforçando a adoção de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software e propondo melhorias no processo.
  • Lidar com incidentes, solucionar e depurar problemas de software com uma mentalidade de aprendizado. Criar postmortems e tomar ações para evitar incidentes semelhantes no futuro.
  • Melhorar ativamente a forma como construímos nossos serviços front-end e pavimentar o caminho para resolver novos desafios.
  • Contribuir para o crescimento da equipe de engenharia, mentorizando e fornecendo orientação técnica aos engenheiros de software.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de revisões de código e design, além de monitoramento de produção.
  • Garantir a qualidade e confiabilidade do software implementando metodologias de testes eficazes, como testes unitários e plataformas de testes automatizados.

O que oferecemos:

  • VA/VR: No Cartão Flash, você utiliza conforme sua conveniência.
  • Plano de saúde: Amil.
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Plano Pet: da Petlove.
  • Descontos especiais com a Esalq USP e outras instituições de ensino, visando potencializar seu desenvolvimento.
  • Incentivo para desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Clube de descontos.
  • TotalPass.
  • Licença maternidade/paternidade.
  • Auxílio Creche.
  • Dia de folga no aniversário.
  • Seguro de vida.

Localização: Nossa equipe de engenharia adota o modelo remote-first, o que significa que trabalhamos predominantemente de casa, com a flexibilidade de viver em qualquer lugar do Brasil. Também oferecemos a opção de utilizar nosso escritório em São Paulo, com reuniões presenciais agendadas conforme a demanda.

title: Software Engineer, Integrations
description:
We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

About Topsort

Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic that’s had rapid growth since out of a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a hardworking team of talented individuals. Since our founding in 2021, we’ve gained customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps in 40+ countries and quickly approaching the #1 position in the industry.

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact, being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s do the unimaginable - let’s make ads clean and cool again, with AI and modern technology.

What it’s like to work at Topsort

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. It’s a sports team that’s hyper focused on winning, collaborative internally, and competitive externally - never the other way around. We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

About the role

We’re looking for aPassionate, Communicative, and Client-Facing hands-on Integration Engineer to join our fast-growing engineering team at Topsort! This is not just another engineering role —here, you’ll have the opportunity to take full ownership of integrations, working directly withcustomers to shape how our cutting-edge retail media API solutions seamlessly connect with the world’s leading retailers, marketplaces, and delivery apps.

Key Responsabilities

  • Own the entire integration process – You won’t just be following instructions; you’ll beleading integrations end-to-end , solving complex challenges, and acting as atrusted technical advisor to our clients.
  • Be the bridge between tech & customer success – Work directly with clients, engineers, and product teams to deeply understand their needs andensure seamless API integrations . Your solutions won’t just be functional—they’ll be impactful and user-friendly, strengthening long-term customer relationships.
  • Solve real-world challenges with agility – Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize integrations fortop-tier retailers and marketplaces , ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently. Your quick thinking and hands-on problem-solving will directly enhance the client experience.
  • Build stronger client relationships – This isn’t just a technical role; you’ll be theface of our engineering team in APAC , helping customers navigate their integration journey. You’llown key client interactions , build trust, andbecome a go-to expert for their integration needs.
  • Experience the world – This role comes with international travel opportunities, allowing you towork directly with global clients , visit their offices, and immerse yourself in different cultures. If you enjoymeeting people, collaborating in person, and making an impact globally ,this is the role for you!
  • Build smarter tools & automation – Developinternal tools and frameworks to streamline and simplify integrations, making them more scalable and efficient for future clients.
  • Career Growth & Leadership – As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into a leadership role andpotentially build your own team in the future .

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • Strong communication skills and experience interacting with customers and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in building integration tools and APIs.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, data formats (JSON, XML), and authentication methods (OAuth).
  • Preferred experience: Experience in SaaS integrations or ad tech. Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) tools and integration platforms.
  • Availability to work 4 days per week onsite at our Sao Paulo Office.

Topsort Culture

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. We thrive on working together, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

  • Direct and Speedy: we move quickly, experiment boldly, and get things done today, not tomorrow. Feedback is candid, and the drive for constant improvement is part of our DNA.
  • Ideas > Titles: We believe the best ideas win, regardless of who they come from. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it.
  • Embrace a Sports Team Mentality: We're only competitive externally, and very collaborative internally. Everyone plays a vital role, and together, we win as a team.
  • Silicon Valley to the World: Founded by Stanford and Harvard alumni during the pandemic, we offer flexible working arrangements and (at least) one in-person offsite gathering per year to stay connected as a team.

Topsort is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Página da Vaga | Banco de Talentos - Para Economistas
description:
Esse é um Banco de Talentos exclusivo para pessoas formadas em economia.

Estamos sempre em busca de talentos para enriquecer nossa equipe; a ideia é reunir talentos que façam sentindo para futuras oportunidades.

A posição de analista demanda boa capacidade de escrita e habilidades em desenvolver trabalhos analíticos, além de conhecimentos específicos de cada área da LCA, como estatística, econometria, microeconomia, macroeconomia, avaliação econômico-financeira.

Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, criatividade, liderança, proatividade, comprometimento, flexibilidade, colaboração, resiliência, curiosidade, capacidade analítica, diferentes perfis e investimos nas fortalezas individuais.

O preenchimento da futura vaga entre analista júnior, pleno ou sênior dependerá das experiências prévias, qualificações e perfil do(a) candidato(a).

As oportunidades poderão ser no formato híbrido ou remoto, conforme a necessidade de cada área.

Se você se identifica com a LCA, cadastre-se no nosso Banco de Talentos e lembre-se de manter o seu perfil atualizado. Fazemos uma triagem entre currículos cadastrados toda vez que uma vaga é aberta; reforçamos, porém, que alguns currículos podem acabar não sendo selecionados nessa triagem e a atualização do perfil também envolve a candidatura a vagas específicas.

Importante: por se tratar de um Banco de Talentos, não temos nenhuma previsão definitiva de quando a posição será aberta. Por isso, fique atento aos canais de comunicação.

A LCA é a maior consultoria econômica do Brasil. Atende clientes nacionais e internacionais nas áreas de finanças e em análises econômicas que envolvem regulação, políticas públicas, litígios, entre outros.

São aproximadamente 50 economistas, que atuam de forma integrada, agregando sinergias para o desenvolvimento de trabalhos de excelência.

Somos a única consultoria da América Latina ranqueada no Global Competition Review 100 e no Latin Lawyer 250.

Atribuímos o nosso sucesso à equipe, que une habilidades diversificadas e engajamento no trabalho em equipe.

O envolvimento em projetos é profundo, completo e imediato. O treinamento é na realidade. O ambiente é colaborativo, você sempre terá o suporte de todos.

Buscamos sempre construir um ótimo lugar para trabalhar e valorizamos o equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Respeitamos a individualidade e damos muita atenção a situações pessoais.

Atuamos pela diversidade e inclusão na LCA

A LCA valoriza a diversidade e incentiva a candidatura de pessoas que fazem parte dos grupos subrepresentados no mercado de trabalho: mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIA+, PCD e outros.

Desde setembro de 2021 temos um programa estruturado para promover a diversidade e um ambiente inclusivo. Temos atuado em governança, engajamento interno e atração e desenvolvimento de talentos com diversidade.

Promovemos conversas e palestras periódicas com pessoas convidadas de outras empresas e líderes de movimentos pro-diversidade.

Instituímos o Comitê de Inclusão e Diversidade que, aliado à alta direção, realizou o levantamento da situação das mulheres na LCA – que têm forte presença na liderança –; o censo de diversidade; e depois de um ano de programa, a pesquisa de inclusão e respeito pessoal e profissional.

Com base no que aprendemos, publicamos o Guia de boas práticas em respeito e inclusão, que você podeconsultar aqui .

Revimos nossas práticas de recrutamento e seleção com vistas a atrair e promover a diversidade. Estamos ativamente buscando pessoas não só de variadas características, como de diversas origens, formações e lugares de morada.

Nos primeiros doze meses do programa conseguimos contratar uma proporção três vezes maior de pessoas negras e LGBT em relação à média anterior – chegando a mais de 30% de representação de cada um desses grupos nas novas contratações.

Nossas pessoas pertencentes a grupos de diversidade recomendam a LCA para pessoas como elas trabalharem –veja aqui um resumo dos resultados da pesquisa. Estamos no começo, temos muito o que aprender e melhorar, e estes primeiros resultados só nos encorajam a seguir em frente.

Liderar o time de Sourcing/Procurement na condução das negociações e interfaces com fornecedores e parceiros. Alcançar as melhores condições contratuais, com os fornecedores adequados. Liderar o time na execução de projetos e programas de melhoria, buscando constantemente por oportunidades de melhoria de competitividade e produtividade.

Job Description

  • Colaborar para a manutenção dos programas de qualidade e melhoria contínua, seguindo padrões e procedimentos, identificando potenciais melhorias e agindo para implementá-las.
  • Administrar a equipe de trabalho, selecionando, orientando, treinando, monitorando o desempenho, avaliando o desempenho, fazendo cumprir os procedimentos organizacionais e normas de segurança, bem como programando férias e interagindo com outras questões envolvendo a gestão de pessoal.
  • EHS: Manter o compromisso primário com o Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (EHS), cumprindo todos os requisitos legais e procedimentos internos aplicáveis ao seu local de trabalho. Engajar-se na prevenção de lesões, doenças relacionadas ao trabalho e poluição, relatando prontamente qualquer incidente, evento ou preocupação relacionada ao EHS.
  • QUALIDADE: Manter o compromisso primário com o Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ), cumprindo todos os requisitos referentes à Certificação ISO 9001 por meio de procedimentos internos aplicáveis ao seu local de trabalho. Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Analista de Vendas Senior Customer Service - John Crane - São Paulo
description:
John Crane, uma empresa do Smiths Group, é líder global em soluções de controle de fluxo de missão crítica para indústrias de energia e processos que permitem operações eficientes e sustentáveis. Nossos produtos incluem selos e sistemas mecânicos, acoplamentos, rolamentos, sistemas de filtragem e tecnologias de monitoramento digital preditivo.

Temos uma rede global de mais de 200 locais em mais de 50 países e empregamos mais de 6.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Estabelecemos parcerias com nossos clientes para ajudá-los a manter suas operações seguras, reduzir o tempo de inatividade, melhorar a eficiência e atender aos mais recentes padrões ambientais.

John Crane faz parte do Grupo Smiths. Por mais de 170 anos, a Smiths tem sido pioneira no progresso da engenharia para um futuro melhor. Servimos milhões de pessoas todos os anos, ajudando a criar um mundo mais seguro, mais eficiente, produtivo e mais bem conectado em quatro mercados globais: energia, segurança e defesa, espaço e aeroespacial e industrial em geral. Listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres, a Smiths emprega aproximadamente 16.000 colegas em mais de 50 países.

Descrição da vaga

Apoiar o engenheiro de vendas no atendimento aos clientes, incluindo recebimento de cotações, elaboração de propostas comerciais com precificação e tributos, e suporte em dúvidas sobre prazos, faturamento, logística e demais solicitações.

Processar pedidos de venda no sistema e encaminhá-los para as áreas responsáveis (fábrica ou engenharia), garantindo agilidade na produção dos materiais.

Assegurar a qualidade, precisão e sigilo das informações e serviços sob sua responsabilidade.

Atuar em conformidade com o Código de Ética Empresarial, normas de segurança do trabalho, meio ambiente e padrões de qualidade da empresa.

Manter-se atualizado com inovações do setor, contribuindo com sugestões de melhorias em processos e equipamentos.

Participar da descrição, revisão e cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais da área.

Executar outras atividades relacionadas à função, conforme orientação da liderança.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursandonas áreas de Administração, Contabil ou afins.
  • Inglês técnico básico.
  • Experiência na área comercial de +3 anos.
  • Vivência na área fiscal.

Informações adicionais

Com colegas espalhados por todo o mundo, estamos orgulhosos da nossa diversidade. Para promover a inclusão, administramos grupos de recursos de funcionários (ERGs) para fornecer um espaço seguro para os funcionários se conectarem e apoiarem uns aos outros. Nossos ERGs interempresariais incluem Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Network e Neurodiversity.

Em toda a nossa empresa, reconhecemos a excelência, culminando nos Smiths Excellence Awards, a nossa celebração anual das atividades, pessoas e projetos mais extraordinários que melhor mostram os nossos pontos fortes e ajudam a impulsionar o nosso negócio. description:
Join to apply for the Azure Machine Learning Engineer role at Netrix Global .

Netrix Global is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer within the Professional Services – Data Intelligence department. The role involves researching, building, designing, and maintaining artificial intelligence systems responsible for machine learning. The engineer will also serve as a key communicator between data science team members, working with data scientists and operational teams.

About The Opportunity

The Machine Learning Engineer will be a vital part of the data science team, focusing on AI systems development and improvement.

  • Prepare data for AI and GenAI solutions.
  • Ensure integration of AI solutions within cloud architectures, including security and governance.

  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML Studio, and other Azure data tools.

  • Proficiency with DevOps tools and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

Location

Argentina (any part of the country is suitable)

Shift

9 a.m to 6 p.m, Monday to Friday

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive benefits including Swiss Medical coverage
  • AWS certifications
  • Discounts, connectivity, competitive salary, remote work, and a supportive learning environment

About Us

Netrix Global values outcomes, teamwork, impact, enjoyment, and respect. We are committed to providing scalable, secure, data-driven solutions to complex business challenges.

What You Can Expect From Us

Competitive compensation, benefits, flexibility, casual environment, remote work options, and inclusive hiring practices. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

title: Coordenador de Tesouraria
description:
Coordenador de Tesouraria para integrar nossa equipe de Finanças Corporativas. Será responsável por garantir que a equipe cumpra, com ética, responsabilidade e transparência, todos os procedimentos, políticas e processos financeiros da empresa, suas coligadas e controladas. Orientar-se por resultados, buscando constantemente simplificar e digitalizar atividades. Garantir a acuracidade dos dados e a integração de informações com áreas fornecedoras e clientes, zelando pela qualidade e pontualidade dos reportes sob sua responsabilidade. Liderar projetos que impactem a gestão de caixa e a execução das estratégias financeiras da alta direção.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Construir, acompanhar e atualizar o fluxo de caixa diário e direto das empresas geridas (previsto x realizado);
  2. Construir, acompanhar e atualizar o indicador de dívida e investimentos (previsto x realizado);
  3. Responder pela criação, manutenção e divulgação de indicadores de performance;
  4. Responder pela criação, manutenção e divulgação de reportes de Tesouraria (locais e internacionais);
  5. Liderar projetos sob responsabilidade da área;
  6. Suportar a alta gestão com estudos e avaliações financeiras;
  7. Acompanhar/cobrar a execução das SLAs financeiras com o CSM (prazo mínimo de pagamento, conciliação de contas, previsão de entradas, zeragem de contas, confirmação de lançamentos, entre outros);
  8. Negociar operações de câmbio e derivativos – hedge;
  9. Gerir e formar a equipe;
  10. Apoiar o superior na definição, negociação e formalização de operações financeiras;
  11. Elaborar, acompanhar e executar os KPIs definidos para a área a cada período.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou Engenharia;
  • Pós-graduação desejável;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em departamentos financeiros de grandes empresas (indústria, comércio ou varejo);
  • Sólida experiência em gestão de equipes;
  • Pacote Office avançado (ênfase em Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Desejável conhecimento em PowerBI;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em Matemática financeira, operações financeiras (passivas e ativas), fluxos operacionais financeiros;
  • Habilidades de comunicação, negociação, resiliência, gestão de tempo e relacionamento interpessoal.

Informações adicionais

  • Vale transporte;
  • Convênio médico;
  • Telemedicina;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Convênio farmácia;
  • Wellhub;
  • Remuneração variável;
  • Plataforma de e-learning.

title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.
The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.
Location: This is a Globally remote role
What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.
Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.
  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

Join to apply for the L20130 Regional Corporate Counsel role at Epson do Brasil

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Regional Corporate Counsel
A Regional Corporate Counsel specializing in corporate transactional work to provide expert legal advice and support for Epson's Industrial line of business, including strategic initiatives. This role involves drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements, managing transactions, and advising on compliance and government regulations. This position will require building relationships with senior management to create appropriate legal strategies to advance the Epson’s business goals in the Latin American region.
Key Responsibilities
Transactional Support:

  • Provide legal counsel on all aspects of corporate transactions, including strategic business deals and government sales.
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating a wide range of contracts and agreements, including customer sales agreements, distribution agreements, product lease agreements, loyalty program terms and conditions, master service agreements, NDAs, licensing agreements, policies and guidelines, release and consent forms.
  • Identify and manage legal risks associated with transactions and business operations, including government sales and bid transactions.
Advice And Counsel
  • Responsible for: managing an active portfolio of legal issues with respect to Epson Industrial products and services with moderate to high-risk implications and supporting the Company’s transactional requirements with tailored contracts.
  • Advise as to compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and policies within relevant areas.
  • Assesses legal risks and opportunities, establishes and advocates plans to minimize risks at levels acceptable to businesses supported.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external counsel, and provide training to internal clients as needed.
  • Shapes and advocates company’s positions to internal and external audiences regarding a variety of legal and business matters.
  • Coordinates efforts with internal and/or external legal and business experts when appropriate.
  • Communicates business risk tolerance to outside counsel to effect best outcomes.
Relationship Management
  • Advises Legal department managers regarding local laws, regulations and issues and provides recommendations on problematic conditions that require escalation.
  • Collaborates with Key Customers and EAI mid- to senior management across various parts of the organization, with emphasis on support for those involved with 1) Industrial Sales and Marketing, 2) Finance, Tax, Import/Export, and 3) EAI and Seiko Epson Legal/Compliance.
  • Builds strong relationships with peers and senior management to best meet company goals and objectives.
Department Management
  • Operates within budgetary constraints.
  • Develops and maintains written departmental standards and procedures.
Reports to: Assistant General Counsel (Epson America)
Language: Portuguese, English and Spanish
Legal Expertise
  • A Juris Doctor (JD) degree and admission to the bar (or Brazilian equivalent).
  • Several years of experience in a large law firm (preferred) and at a multinational corporation (required).
  • Proven experience in corporate transactions, contracts, and other commercial deals.
  • Strong negotiation and drafting skills, with the ability to effectively communicate legal concepts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to handle complex legal issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

description:
️ Essa vaga é para as novas teses da Talentum. Focada em empresas que estão em fase de pré-criação e que serão lançadas em breve. Se você sonha em construir uma empresa B2B e SaaS do zero, queremos conversar com você!
Procuramos pessoas que tenham o potencial e o desejo de se tornarem um Cofundador(a) técnico hands-on em uma startup nascente. Reconhecemos que a experiência e o conhecimento para essa construção pode vir de diversas fontes, pois não há uma trajetória única por trás de jornadas bem-sucedidas de empreendedorismo.
️Abaixo, estão alguns dos caminhos que, se você viveu, indicam uma chance mais alta de alinhamento ao que buscamos, cada um com seu diferente nível de experiência e potencial.

  • Experiência empreendedora prévia: ter (co)fundado uma empresa real, que independente do seu sucesso, conseguiu construir um produto, gerar algumas vendas e reter clientes.
  • Experiência em startups de alto crescimento: ter feito parte do time fundador e/ou time inicial de uma startup que viveu uma jornada de alto crescimento, entre as fases mercadologicamente marcadas como "Pré-seed" a "Series B".
  • ️ Experiência em Big Techs: ter trabalhado em funções de alto impacto (técnicas ou gerenciais) em empresas de tecnologia de ponta.
  • Experiência em consultorias: ter trabalhado pelo menos 2 anos em uma empresa de consultoria de referência.
  • Experiência como liderança: ter liderado pessoas em algum nível (colaboradores individuais ou líderes) durante a jornada.
  • Início de carreira com disposição ao generalismo: pessoas com alto potencial e intensa motivação, com visão sistêmica, mas sem conexões com capital.
️Essa não é uma lista exaustiva de requisitos. Nossa principal busca é por pessoas com intensa motivação e dispostas a viver a jornada empreendedora, com todos os sacrifícios que ela envolve.
️ Procuramos pessoas para empreender, e não colaboradores individuais — portanto, é preciso ter disposição para viver os altos e baixos da jornada early stage, e, independente da função executiva, fazer o que for preciso para a empresa prosperar, desde papéis estratégicos até os operacionais.
Os Diferenciais Da Talentum
A Talentum atua como um Co-fundador ativo e mão-na-massa, além de ser o primeiro investidor. Trazemos vantagens competitivas únicas, que empresas nascidas sozinhas não têm:
  • Contamos com um time qualificado e multidisciplinar para construir junto com você. Atuamos lado a lado desde o início, com especialistas em tecnologia, jurídico, backoffice, financeiro, relacionamento com investidores e vendas. Oferecemos suporte estratégico e operacional para acelerar o desenvolvimento do negócio de forma sólida e conectada com o mercado.
  • Temos playbooks que detalham cada passo da operação de uma empresa nascente.
  • Acessamos uma rede de mentores experientes: sempre que desafios complexos surgem, temos à nossa disposição uma rede de mentores experientes da indústria para auxiliar na discussão, guiando os empreendedores para a solução do problema.
  • Somos os primeiros investidores da empresa: com nossa injeção de caixa, suportamos a operação da empresa durante os momentos iniciais, para que os fundadores possam buscar as primeiras fontes de receita enquanto constroem seus mínimos produtos viáveis e suas operações.
  • Boilerplate de tecnologia: você contará com um boilerplate + design system robusto disponibilizado pela Talentum, para acelerar o desenvolvimento dos produtos.

Join to apply for the Attaché de coopération universitaire (F/H) role at Ministère des Affaires étrangères français .

Description synthétique du poste

Sous l’autorité du Conseiller de coopération et d’action culturelle (COCAC) et de la COCAC-adjointe, qui pilote le secteur science/technologie/universités, vous exercerez la coordination et participerez au pilotage stratégique, administratif et financier d’un opérateur de l'action extérieure, Campus France Brésil, afin de contribuer à la gestion et à la performance de l'organisation. Vous participerez également à la coopération universitaire, tant au niveau national qu'au niveau de la circonscription consulaire de São Paulo.

Activités principales

Les missions se déclinent comme suit :

  • Direction Campus France Brésil (75%)
  • Coordination de l’équipe dans ses missions de gestion de la procédure « études en France » et de promotion des études en France, sous l’autorité du COCAC et du COCAC adjoint. L’équipe comprend : 1 VIA, 4 ADL à São Paulo (administration, gestion, finance ; promotion et communication ; informatique et support technique ; plateforme Etudes en France et dossiers étudiants), ainsi que 5 ADL responsables d’espaces Campus France (2 à São Paulo, 3 dans les antennes de Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Recife). Les missions incluent l'élaboration du budget, la supervision des services, la coordination des activités promotionnelles, la gestion du réseau des espaces Campus France, le suivi des tableaux de bord, la participation aux événements et la création d’un réseau de partenaires brésiliens et français.
  • Actions de coopération universitaire (25%)
  • En soutien à la direction de Campus France, vous aiderez au développement de programmes de mobilité, à la co-construction de programmes de bourses, à la veille stratégique sur de nouveaux programmes de coopération, et à la diffusion d’informations sur la coopération universitaire franco-brésilienne, en coordination avec l’attachée scientifique et technique de la circonscription de São Paulo.

Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée

Master ou Doctorat, avec une connaissance approfondie du système de l’enseignement supérieur en France, notamment en relations internationales. Expérience confirmée en promotion internationale de l’enseignement supérieur et en montage de projets de coopération universitaire, en France ou à l’étranger, avec une capacité à gérer une équipe dans un environnement international.

This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.)

    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions

  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?
Watch Our Story:' and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.
Toll Facility Market Lead
As part of HDR’s Highways and Roads market sector, the toll facility market lead will be responsible to support our local areas with the identification and development of projects and programs where HDR can bring our suite of professional services to toll facility clients. Toll facility clients include agencies and authorities that own, operate and maintain roads, bridges and tunnels that charge fees to users that travel on their facilities.
Toll facilities will be a sub-sector to HDR’s highways and roads market sector within the transportation business group. Services that the toll facility market lead will look to bring to these clients include:

  • Planning and Design services including, roadway, bridges, tunnels, transport hydraulics and geotechnical
  • Mobility and operational technology services including ATST, ITS, CAV, tolling system development and operations, managed lanes, ZEM and OT cybersecurity
  • Advisory services including asset management, ROW, value engineering, funding and finance
  • Building and facility design
The toll facility market lead will be responsible for the growth and success of tolling services and programs for toll road clients and will be expected to work with area business development leaders and business group managers to:
  • Develop and share knowledge of trends and drivers within the toll market
  • Support areas in the identification, pursuit and delivery of area toll facility client opportunities where HDR can compete and deliver professional services
  • Support areas in the research of toll facility clients in their markets and help develop client relationships that include local area teams and market sector teams
  • Support TBG region directors in the evaluation and prioritization of toll facility client investments and opportunities across their regions and the business group as the program expands
The toll facility market lead will be an individual with established relationships with toll facility agencies and authorities and someone with a reputation of leading programs in the highway/roads market.
This role will be expected to work with HDR leaders across the business group to broaden the range of toll services offered by HDR and to provide professional development for staff as they provide services to toll facility clients.
The toll facility market lead will be expected to support local area and business group leaders in the identification and participation of industry organizations that will contribute to the growth of HDR with toll facility clients and within the highway and roads market sector.
The toll facility market lead will lead HDR’s strategy for presence and leadership in industry organizations including IBTTA and others.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Recognized Leader in the Toll Roads/Toll Facilities space
  • Proved ability to set the strategy and execute the strategy for growth of a practice, ideally in the Tolling market
  • Established relationships with major tolling clients/DOT's
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree in an architecture, engineering, planning or a related field
  • A minimum of 10 years of industry experience
  • Experienced in development and management of strategic marketing programs for architecture, engineering and or planning services
  • Experienced in development and management of a wide range of client relationships and specific program and/or project pursuits
  • Experienced in overall staff development to include recruiting, career path and professional growth
  • Experienced with industry associations and maintains a visible profile in the market sector
  • Ability to work cooperatively with Area Market Sector Directors, Market Sector Directors, Business Class Directors, Regional Business Group Director, Area Business Group Managers, Area Marketing Managers and Area Managers
  • Demonstrated commitment to HDR values. An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must
What We Believe
HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.
Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker role at Canonical

2 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: This role can be based in Americas and the assigned territory will be Chile. Being based in Chile is therefore preferable.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as Spanish for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Who we are?

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owner to define and document the requirements for building an access rights management application suitable for the organisation.

  • Create business process workflows and system designs as per the collected requirements.
  • Develop the requirements into user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria to be used by Scrum team for development.
  • Work closely with Product Owner, Scrum team to develop the solution using Agile methodology.
  • Use Cucumber or similar tool to document and verify application functionality implementing Behavior Driven Development (BDD) methodology.
  • Assist in defining test cases and validating developed functionalities to ensure alignment with the approved requirements.
  • Ensure the documentation of the developed application is written and accurate.
  • Conduct UAT testing to validate implementation of the requirements.
  • Analyse existing access control processes and recommend improvements for efficiency.
  • Ensure the solution adheres to IAM policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Provide functional expertise in IAM tools and platforms, ensuring optimal configuration and performance.
  • Collaborate with Operations team to troubleshoot access management related issues as needed.
  • Conduct meetings, training sessions, and workshops for key users to ensure smooth adoption of systems.
  • Participate in requirement elicitation and understanding of other solutions within Identity and Access domain.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IAM.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to grow in a demanding, fast-growing organization.
  • Very attractive, multicultural, and friendly work environment in fast-growing international company (more than 60,000 employees now)
  • Possibility to grow and take the next step in your professional career and self-development.
  • A launch pad into various opportunities – within many business lines of Eurofins globally.
  • A chance to become part of a highly motivated international team of professionals.
  • BE/ B.Tech /MCA or any other equivalent degree.
  • Proficiency in English is a must
  • 3-7 years of experience as a Business/ Functional Analyst.
  • Experience in UML, Visio, Draw.io to create domain model, activity diagrams to clarify requirements.
  • Experience with functional designs and tools for user journeys.
  • Experience with agile development and management platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar.
  • Experience in User Training and delivering Application Demonstrations.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear documentation and written materials.
  • Experience working with cross functional teams.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills across various business functions, including management, multinational teams within organization, external partners, and business customers.
  • Ability to engage in constructive discussions, challenge stakeholders, and drive towards optimal solutions.
  • Strong critical thinking abilities with the capacity to question and analyse requests in alignment with regulatory requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Eagerness to learn and develop both personally and technically.
  • Detail-oriented with strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Have strong communication, presentation skills, and the ability to engage in productive discussions to ensure successful solution delivery.

Monday to Friday - 8:00 to 17:00 Hybrid Work

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

THE COMPANY

We are fans who help fans everywhere access the live events they love. As a proud division of Live Nation Entertainment, Ticketmaster has changed the way the world connects with their favourite artists, teams, and shows, and we continue to shape innovation every day. We're not just selling tickets (though we do that better than anyone else!), we’re enriching lives, one amazing experience at a time. And we think that’s incredible. If you’re passionate about the magic of live entertainment like we are, and you want to work for a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want you on our team.


THE JOB

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack .NET Developer to join our team and collaborate on the development of a financial settlement solution for the ticketing industry. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable applications, ensuring the efficiency and reliability of payment settlement processes.

This role is critical to building an innovative system that will optimize the financial flow among event organizers, customers, and payment platforms. If you’re looking for technical challenges and the opportunity to make a direct impact in a dynamic, global sector, this is the position for you!

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Develop and implement software solutions using .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) for web applications and APIs.
  • Design and maintain robust, scalable backend systems, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability in financial transaction processing.
  • Create dynamic and responsive user interfaces using modern front-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Work with SQL Server databases, including modeling, creating and maintaining complex queries, performance optimization, stored procedures, and triggers.
  • Implement unit and integration tests, ensuring code quality and system stability.
  • Apply agile development practices (Scrum, Kanban) for planning, analyzing, designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining solutions.
  • Ensure system security and compliance with regulatory standards and industry best practices for payments.
  • Collaborate with other technical and business teams to align requirements and continuously enhance the platform.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core).
  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server, including data modeling, query optimization, stored procedures, and triggers.
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js).
  • Familiarity with Git version control and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with tools like Jira or Trello.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work in a dynamic, high-impact environment.
  • Experience with payment API integrations or financial systems is a plus.
  • Knowledge of security practices and regulatory compliance in financial systems is a plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Spanish is preferred.

About JumpCloud

JumpCloud delivers a unified open directory platform that makes it easy to securely manage identities, devices, and access across your organization. With JumpCloud, IT teams and MSPs enable users to work securely from anywhere and manage their Windows, Apple, Linux, and Android devices from a single platform. JumpCloud is IT Simplified.

About the Role

The Senior Data Engineer will have a crucial role on the Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) team, an internal, cross-functional analytics team that supports stakeholders across all company’s business units, including Finance, Marketing, Sales, Growth, UX, Customer Success, and Product. The primary responsibility of this role is to drive JumpCloud’s core reporting by developing data pipelines, curating and modeling data, and designing databases to enable insights and self-service across the analytics team and organization.

The Senior Data Engineer will collaborate with analytics teams (EDA, embedded analysts), technical teams (Enterprise Support Systems, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering), and business stakeholders to develop and maintain data pipelines, curated data models, and database designs that will support business and analytics insights throughout the organization.

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about data and continuous improvement. They will have the ability to balance and prioritize multiple projects, ask insightful questions in an ambiguous environment, and coordinate execution across various stakeholders. A proactive and hands-on approach is essential, as JumpCloud is a lean and fast-moving company.


What you’ll be doing:
  • Driving large, impactful projects involving data pipelines, database design, data modeling, and data curation for optimized analytics and business use with involvement across various stakeholders, business units, and technical partners.
  • Owning the outcomes of the analytics initiatives you’re leading. You’re not just a participant in the initiative, you hold yourself responsible for the outcome of the project.
  • Gathering requirements and providing actionable recommendations to technical stakeholders, driving adoption and execution of recommendations.
  • Mentoring and growing the other analysts and engineers across the organization. We’ve got a great organization full of a lot of potential, you’ll be helping the other members of the organization achieve their potential.
  • Supporting team's project management, strategic decision-making, and long-term planning.
  • Staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data engineering, database design, data modeling, and data governance and applying them to support our business needs.
We’re looking for:
  • Advanced knowledge and experience in SQL and relational databases; Snowflake experience highly preferred.
  • Advanced knowledge in database design, data modeling, data infrastructure, data pipelines, and ELT process to support analytics and business operations. DBT, Airflow, Fivetran, AWS, and GitHub experiences are highly preferred.
  • Advanced understanding of coding and markup languages and can create complex queries from multiple data sources, views, and tables and have an understanding of our company's data architecture and how to apply it.
  • Advanced understanding and experience with scripting languages such as Python (numpy, pandas).
  • Intermediate analytical skills and a passion for data storytelling and quantitative analysis.
  • Understanding in one or more business Intelligence / data visualization tools; Tableau experience highly preferred.
  • Strong mentoring skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and desire to learn.
  • Effective stakeholder management skills and communication skills.
  • Effective project management and organizational skills; Agile experience is a plus.
  • Experience with Data Governance best practices.
  • Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, unstructured, dynamic environment.
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems, or another quantitative field.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Marketing at TRACTIAN:

As our Content Manager, you’ll drive our regional content strategy from planning to execution. This includes managing our editorial calendar, optimizing performance across channels, and aligning with business goals.
