Job description

Atuar como líder da integração operacional de uma nova unidade hospitalar adquirida, garantindo o alinhamento com os padrões, diretrizes e processos da organização. Será responsável por mapear, ajustar e implantar processos nas áreas administrativas, financeiras, atendimento, infraestrutura e faturamento, assegurando a padronização e eficiência das operações locais conforme diretrizes da holding.


Main responsibilities

  • Levantar e mapear todos os processos existentes na nova unidade (fluxos administrativos, atendimento, manutenção, RH, faturamento, etc.), identificando desvios em relação ao modelo institucional;
  • Desenvolver plano de ação para adequação dos processos operacionais da unidade incorporada, com cronograma, metas e responsáveis por área;
  • Analisar e reestruturar o controle financeiro da nova unidade (orçamento, fluxo de caixa, contratos, despesas), alinhando com os padrões e metas financeiras da holding;
  • Apoiar a regularização dos contratos de trabalho (CLT e PJ), integração dos colaboradores, ajustes em folha de pagamento, benefícios, ponto eletrônico e estruturação do RH local com base nas políticas institucionais;
  • Promover a integração cultural dos colaboradores da nova unidade com os valores, normas e práticas da organização, assegurando engajamento e alinhamento;
  • Avaliar a jornada do paciente e implementar melhorias no fluxo de atendimento, com foco na padronização da experiência e na humanização;
  • Avaliar a estrutura física da unidade, diagnosticar necessidades de adequação e padronização dos serviços de limpeza, segurança, recepção, manutenção e contratos de facilities;
  • Estruturar e garantir o correto funcionamento do processo de faturamento, cobrança e integração dos sistemas de informação;
  • Implantar os indicadores operacionais utilizados pela holding e assegurar sua rotina de análise e reporte;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios periódicos de desempenho operacional, riscos, não conformidades e plano de melhoria à gestão central;
  • Garantir que os fluxos operacionais estejam em conformidade com os demais hospitais e clínicas da instituição, promovendo integração sistêmica;
  • Apoiar o levantamento de pendências legais, tributárias, sanitárias ou trabalhistas da unidade, articulando com áreas especialistas para tratativas.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia, Gestão Hospitalar ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Saúde, Projetos, Finanças ou Operações (desejável);
  • Experiência em liderança de operações administrativas em unidades de saúde (hospital, clínica, laboratório);
  • Experiência prévia com processos de integração ou incorporação de unidades será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento de rotinas de RH, financeiro, faturamento hospitalar, contratos, infraestrutura e atendimento ao cliente;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e indicadores operacionais.
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em eficiência operacional;
  • Capacidade de gestão de mudanças e integração cultural;
  • Liderança com senso de dono e habilidade para tomada de decisão;
  • Comunicação clara e habilidade de articulação entre áreas;
  • Organização, planejamento e disciplina;
  • Alta capacidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas;
  • Resiliência e habilidade para lidar com ambientes em transição.

As the hub of all claims, the coordinator is responsible for speaking with the customer, ongoing customer follow up, handling service complaints, logistics of dispatching field personnel to jobs while ensuring that the required Cycle Time and insurance Service Level Agreement tasks deadlines are met.   8. Understanding of all company cycle times and SLAs required for each job and phase.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Business Development Manager with extensive experience in SaaS sales and prospecting, specializing in the Brazilian government sector (public administration, agencies, and state-owned enterprises). The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of selling SaaS solutions to government entities, navigating complex procurement processes (Licitações), and driving digital transformation in the public sector.

Knowledge of ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) and corporate governance is a strong plus, as many government contracts now require sustainability and compliance considerations. Experience with CRM HubSpot is essential for managing pipelines, tracking interactions, and optimizing sales processes.

Key Responsibilities

· Prospecting & Lead Generation:

o Identify and target government agencies, public institutions, and state-owned companies that can benefit from our SaaS solutions, with a focus on board digital transformation, efficiency, and ESG-aligned projects.

o Use HubSpot CRM to track leads, manage pipelines, and automate outreach (email sequences, call logs, deal stages).

o Leverage databases such as ComprasNet, Portal de Licitações, and Diário Oficial to find bidding opportunities, including those with ESG and Board Portal opportunities.

o Develop tailored outreach strategies, including cold calling, LinkedIn engagement, and participation in public sector events.

· Sales Strategy & Execution:

o Lead the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to contract signing, including responding to RFPs (Editais), drafting proposals, and negotiating terms.

o Work closely with marketing, product, and legal teams to align proposals with government needs, emphasizing corporate governance, data security, and sustainability benefits.

· Relationship Building:

o Build and maintain relationships with government decision-makers (gestores públicos, secretários, TI governamental, procurement officers, and ESG compliance teams).

o Act as a trusted advisor, demonstrating how our SaaS solutions support efficiency, transparency, and ESG goals (e.g., reducing carbon footprint, improving social impact, ensuring governance compliance).

o Attend government tech conferences, ESG forums, and public sector innovation events to expand influence.

· Market & Competitive Intelligence:

o Monitor trends in GovTech, digital government (Governo Digital), ESG regulations, and public sector sustainability initiatives.

o Analyze competitors and adjust sales strategies to highlight our ESG and governance advantages.

o Provide feedback to the product team on government-specific needs (security, LGPD compliance, ESG reporting integrations, etc.).

· Revenue Growth & Reporting:

o Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.

o Use HubSpot dashboards and reports to track performance and forecast revenue.

o Ensure accurate CRM updates for sales transparency.

Qualifications & Experience

· 4+ years in B2B SaaS sales, with at least 2 years selling to the Brazilian public sector (municipal, state, or federal government).

· Proven experience in closing deals via licitações (Tomada de Preços, Convite, Pregão Eletrônico) and direct negotiations.

· Strong knowledge of public procurement processes (Lei 14.133/21) and compliance requirements (LGPD, security certifications, ESG frameworks).

· Advanced HubSpot CRM proficiency (deal tracking, automation, reporting).

· ESG and corporate governance knowledge is a plus

· Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills (Portuguese fluent, English mandatory for internal matters).

· Ability to work independently in a structured, metrics-driven environment.

Why Join Us?

· Opportunity to drive innovation in Brazil's public sector with cutting-edge SaaS solutions that align with ESG and corporate governance trends.

· Competitive salary (base + uncapped commissions) + annual performance bonus

· Company notebook

· Office located in Paulista Avenue

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps.
Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. They are also central to the health of critical infrastructure across the globe. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users.
While Ubuntu has been enormously successful and in many senses leads the industry, we think we can substantially improve our practices, quality and performance in the web services domain. We are growing our teams, and in doing so we aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices.
Key areas of interest for us are:

  • API design, documentation, and governance
  • Database performance design considerations and skills

Location : we have microservices teams with open roles in every time zone.

  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains
  • Experience with cross-compilation
  • Experience with hyperscale public clouds and / or private clouds
  • Experience with designing, building, and running distributed systems
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps.
Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. They are also central to the health of critical infrastructure across the globe. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users.
While Ubuntu has been enormously successful and in many senses leads the industry, we think we can substantially improve our practices, quality and performance in the web services domain. We are growing our teams, and in doing so we aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices.
Key areas of interest for us are:

  • API design, documentation, and governance
  • Database performance design considerations and skills
  • Multi-region service delivery for resilience and performance
  • Fuzzing and other proactive security analysis techniques
  • Tracing and profiling for distributed systems insights
  • Next-generation DevOps practices

What your day will look like
  • Write high-quality, well-designed, and robust software that works at scale

  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains
  • Experience with cross-compilation
  • Experience with hyperscale public clouds and / or private clouds
  • Experience with designing, building, and running distributed systems
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Urban Mobility Consultant role at myGwork - LGBTQ+ Business Community

This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of Service
The Urban Mobility Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the coordination of the project, the operational and technical teams of UN-Habitat offices in Rio de Janeiro, as well as with the local project team.
Work Location
Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil
Expected duration
Five (5) months
Duties and Responsibilities
Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat is starting a project with the municipality of Congonhas, Minas Gerais, in cooperation with the Municipal Planning and Management Department. This project aims to revise the Master Plan and develop the city's Mobility Plan. To achieve the proposed objective, the "Congonhas 2030+2" project is designed to strengthen public capacity and promote a culture of transparent decision-making based on data and information. This will be achieved through diagnostics, analysis, training and the drafting of plans. The Master Plan and the Mobility Plan will be drawn up with the participation of society, configuring them as social pacts that take into account its interpretation of the strengths, potential and challenges of the city's spaces, seeking to improve the population's quality of life. In order to properly implement the project, as well as UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, UN-Habitat is looking for an Urban Mobility Consultant. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Urban Mobility Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Urban Mobility Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Be available for a minimum of one (1) weekly virtual meeting with the project coordination, aiming at: I. Sharing partial results of each deliverable; II. Being readily available to incorporate revisions pointed out by the UN-Habitat team in the ongoing activities; III. Defining with the project coordination a feasible workplan, considering intermediary deliveries prior each product deadline, allowing the UN-Habitat team to review the content prior to its approval for payment; IV. Supporting project planning. b) Consider that achieving the completion of each Product on the expected delivery date depends on the Consultant’s ability and commitment to present partial results, following a detailed timeline to be validated with the project coordination in the first week after signing the contract. Overall, the Consultant shall guarantee the execution of its activities accordingly to the main project schedule, being responsible for the deliverables according to deadlines. c) Be available to oversee field work and participate in public events related to the participatory process of developing the Mobility Plan. d) Reports and documents must be developed using the project templates that the UN-Habitat team will provide, in the .ppt, .doc and .indd formats. e) Arrange the software and equipment required to the development of its activities. f) Maintain an orderly and accessible information file system on the information and data produced. g) Arrange equipment to carry out the field work, including film cameras. h) Ensure that the technical activities are aligned with the quality expectations of UN-Habitat and the project counterpart. The Consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The Consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Urban Mobility Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Report on Participatory Engagement Activities – Mobility Plan Expected completion date: 30 days after contract signature The following activities must be performed: a. Preparing documents for the participatory diagnostics process of the Municipal Mobility Plan (presentations, booklets, banners, etc.). b. Supporting the creation of internet content. c. Participating in regional workshops, when requested by the UN-Habitat team. d. Participating in thematic workshops in the municipality: public transport, active mobility, road traffic for people and freight, among others. e. Providing support for an online public consultation. f. Systematizing the results obtained from all the participatory activities carried out. Product 2: Final Plan and draft for the law Expected completion date: 90 days after contract signature The following activities must be performed: a. Consolidation of the Municipal Urban Mobility Plan (technical document). b. Participation in the feedback public hearing. c. Consolidation of the draft of the law and submission to the City Council.
Qualifications/special Skills
Education Required:

  • Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Engineering, Urban Studies, Architecture and Urbanism or related fields is required, or additional four (4) years of relevant technical experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Urban Studies, Architecture and Urbanism or related fields. Work experience:
  • A minimum of six (6) years of experience providing technical support for the development of urban mobility plans and projects is required.
  • Professional experience developing urban mobility plans and projects and other initiatives related to sustainable urban mobility in municipalities with characteristics similar to Congonhas, Minas Gerais, is required.
  • Professional/academic knowledge on themes related to sustainable urban mobility, public transport, road infrastructure, and initiatives focused on prioritizing active transport for pedestrians is desirable.
  • Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
  • Excellent writing and proof-reading skills in Portuguese is required.
  • Good computer skills in Windows, as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines is required.
  • Good command of geographical information systems (GIS) software, such as QGIS, MapInfo and ArcGIS, is desirable. Competencies
  • Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
  • Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
  • Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
  • The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
  • The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
  • The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
  • The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
  • The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
  • The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
  • The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
  • English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
  • For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of Spanish and English is desirable.

Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Sales Operations Analysts to join a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be a leader who shows initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions.
The role entails

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Review opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Manager to improve sales data quality and processes
  • Report on data quality metrics to executive level stakeholders
  • Implement surveys and define metrics for executive level stakeholders
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Lead automation and streamline the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience in a sales operations/sales order processing role
  • Experience in a technology subscription-based business
  • Experience driving data quality improvement
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to manage across boundaries and communicate effectively, particularly working with Sales, Legal, Finance and Marketing teams
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

COMPANY:
ABOUT US:
At Tag Lending Group, we pride ourselves on being the Goldman Sachs of the mortgage industry. We offer a systematic digital experience through our proprietary Roadmap to Home Ownership , powered by advanced AI technology, providing clear financial direction and personalized support. Our licensed Mortgage Loan Originators are dedicated to guiding clients every step of the way.

POSITION SUMMARY:
As a Mortgage Lead & Realtor Account Representative, you will manage inbound and outbound calls, engaging with clients and prospects nationwide. Utilizing cutting-edge AI technology and marketing tools, you will receive leads and inquiries, guide clients through their mortgage needs, and deliver essential information. Your role involves building and nurturing strong relationships, analyzing financial scenarios, and offering tailored solutions in a high-call-volume, fast-paced environment. While we provide leads and Realtor connections, we also encourage proactive efforts to grow your client base through exceptional service. Additionally, you'll be expected to attend open houses on weekends, with one weekend off per month.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: (You Will Be Tested)

  • Provide Accurate Information: Offer clear, precise details on mortgage products and services.
  • Client Engagement: Build strong rapport by actively listening and addressing client needs effectively.

  • CRM Proficiency: Utilize advanced CRM tools to maintain client records and follow up on leads efficiently.
  • Tech Savvy: Prove your technical proficiency in tools such as Slack, Arrive, HubSpot, Outlook, Birdeye, Box, and others (testing will be conducted).
  • Customer Service Excellence: Actively contribute to business growth through outstanding customer service.
  • Follow-Up Skills: Adhere to company playbooks and weekly schedules; if follow-up is not an 8/10, do not apply.
  • Loan Structuring: Engage with clients to identify suitable mortgage products, lock loans at the point of sale, and submit preliminary paperless loan packages.
  • Compliance: Ensure adherence to 14-day close requirements and loan stipulations.
  • Loan Types Expertise: Efficiently manage Conventional, VA, FHA, USDA, and other loan types (you will be tested).

  • Current, valid NMLS license or appointment in good standing. (2-Year Minium or do not fill this out)
  • Minimum two years of sales experience and at least two years as a Mortgage Loan Originator or related experience.
  • For newly licensed applicants, a minimum of five years of sales experience is required with a willingness to undergo a month of training.
  • Flexibility to work approximately 40-45 hours per week.
  • Excellent communication and phone etiquette skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-call volume environment.
  • Experience in a call center or customer service role (mortgage or finance experience is a plus).
  • Ability to build rapport with customers and provide a positive client experience.
  • A basic understanding of mortgage terms and products is an advantage.

  • Basic programming skills (e.g., Python, Java) with the ability to quickly understand code logic.
  • Excellent cross-cultural communication and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Job description

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Compliance com ampla experiência em Compliance, responsável por liderar frentes do Programa de Compliance, atuar como referência técnica, orientar áreas de negócio, apoiar auditorias, ministrar treinamentos e sessões de capacitação, realizar avaliação de terceiros, ações de monitoramento e, garantir a conformidade com leis e políticas internas.


Main responsibilities

Os desafios que aguardam por você no próximo destino são:

  • Precisará capacitar e suportar as áreas de negócio para tomada de decisão, considerando as diretrizes do Programa de Compliance da Companhia, legislação e regulamentos aplicáveis ao setor e melhores práticas de Ética & Compliance;
  • Ser o guardião (ã) do programa de Compliance, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento e execução do Programa de Integridade, incluindo a revisão das atividades de monitoramento, as análises de due diligence de terceiros, conforme política e procedimentos, a elaboração e aplicação de treinamentos, orientar os colaboradores quanto às novas políticas, procedimentos, processos e sistemas de Compliance;
  • Deve atuar como orientador para as áreas de negócios, elaborando recomendações de acordo com as diretrizes do Programa de Compliance;
  • Lidar com diferentes áreas e funções os assuntos relacionados à Compliance;
  • Criar uma rede de relacionamento que fomente a disseminação dos conhecimentos e projetos de Compliance;
  • Identificar áreas de riscos e propor melhorias a fim de construir processos mais alinhados com as necessidades da empresa;
  • Avaliar e analisar os riscos dos processos, com base na análise estratégica do negócio, regulamentação e códigos aplicáveis vigentes;
  • Expor soluções e melhorias estratégicas submetendo-as a Coordenação da área.

Requirements and skills

Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:

  • Ensino superior completo em Direito, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas (diploma ou colação de grau);
  • Pacote Office avançado, com o domínio em excel e powerpoint, com foco em geração de relatórios, dashboards e indicadores de Compliance;
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação);
  • Experiência comprovada na área de Compliance;
  • Experiência na gestão e suporte do Programa de Compliance, com foco na elaboração e realização de treinamentos de Compliance e ações de monitoramento;
  • Domínio na criação de apresentações executivas contendo indicadores de Compliance para reporte aos órgãos da Administração da empresa;
  • Conhecimento sobre Governança Corporativa, frameworks, requisitos legais para empresas com ações no mercado;
  • Conhecimento avançado das Leis Anticorrupção (12.846/13, FCPA e UK Bribery);
  • Conhecimento na implementação e gestão de programas de integridade;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas GRC (Gestão de Riscos e Compliance).

O que pode somar ainda mais:

  • Desejável conhecimento em espanhol;
  • Cursos complementares em Compliance (Trabalhista, Digital, LGPD);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Compliance (Uplexis, AML, Inspektor, SAP Integrity, ARIS, Onetrust, etc).
  • Certificação de Compliance (CPC-A, CCEP, CCEP-I);
  • Experiência em empresas reguladas (aeronáutico, financeiro, saúde, etc);

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We are looking for an experienced intellectual property (IP) lawyer to join our global legal team. This role will focus on safeguarding and leveraging the company’s IP portfolio while supporting broader corporate legal needs, including M&A, reorganizations, and governance.


Key Responsibilities
  • You will be responsible for structuring IP protections across our technology stack, coordinating IP elements in strategic transactions, and overseeing day-to-day corporate legal documentation. This is a strategic and hands-on role that requires both technical IP knowledge and experience in transactional and governance work. You will work closely with cross-functional teams in engineering, IT, finance, and marketing across multiple jurisdictions to ensure our innovations are protected and our group structure evolves efficiently and compliantly. The key responsibilities and day-to-day duties of the role include the following:
Intellectual Property Strategy
  • Manage and grow the company’s global IP portfolio, including patents, trademarks, and trade secrets
  • Advise on open-source licensing, software IP, and brand protection strategies
  • Coordinate with external counsel for global filings, enforcement, and oppositions
  • Create internal IP registration, review, and risk procedures
  • Train teams on IP risk, rights, and protection
M&A and Group Reorganization
  • Advise on IP structuring in group reorganizations and corporate transactions
  • Support due diligence, integration, and post-closing matters in M&A deals
  • Draft and negotiate IP assignment, licensing, and transition agreements
  • Analyze and mitigate IP-related risks in strategic transactions
  • Coordinate cross-border legal input with internal stakeholders and advisors
Corporate Legal
  • Draft and review general commercial contracts (NDAs, service agreements, licensing deals)
  • Support entity management, director/shareholder resolutions, and governance filings
  • Assist with documentation related to intercompany arrangements and funding
  • Maintain legal entity databases and document repositories
  • Review vendor and procurement contracts from a legal risk perspective
Governance and Compliance Support
  • Help implement and maintain policies and controls related to IP and legal risk
  • Support board and shareholder processes across jurisdictions
  • Monitor legal developments impacting corporate and IP structuring
  • Ensure group-wide alignment with applicable corporate laws and regulations
Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with engineering and finance teams on IP initiatives
  • Educate business stakeholders on IP, licensing, and contract management best practices
  • Help scale legal operations and knowledge-sharing processes globally
  • Interface with external counsel and advisors as needed
  • Provide clear, concise advice to non-legal teams under time pressure
What You’ll Need
  • The core skills, knowledge, experience and mindset required to be successful in this role include the following:
Experience
  • 7+ years of legal experience, with a focus on IP, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at technology companies
  • Managed patent strategy and portfolio development, including working with engineers to identify patentable innovations, draft technical disclosures, and guide applications through national and international filing procedures
  • Proven track record supporting M&A and group reorganizations from an IP perspective
  • Familiarity with global entity structuring, general corporate contracts and governance
  • Bonus: developed internal frameworks for IP identification and inventor contribution workflows in scaling tech organizations
  • Bonus: led end-to-end patent prosecution lifecycle including prior art searches, claim drafting, office action responses, and coordination with local agents across key jurisdictions (e.g., USPTO, EPO)
Skills
  • Strong command of IP law across jurisdictions (especially patent in the US)
  • Able to see high level strategies and goals and dive into details to deliver creative, pragmatic solutions based on weighted risk analysis, and translate legal obligations into operational processes and controls
  • Skilled at navigating legal ambiguity in fast-changing technical environments while managing multiple important initiatives under time pressure
  • Excellent critical thinking, synthesis and communications skills and able to persuade and influence internal and external stakeholders
  • Familiarity with crypto, DeFi or open-source ecosystems (bonus)
Mindset

title: Agente de Prevenção de Perdas
description:
Job Description

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Responsibilities and assignments

  1. Atender às normas de segurança e procedimentos administrativos da farmácia com o objetivo de zelar pelo patrimônio físico e de pessoal;
  2. Fiscalizar a entrada e saída de clientes, colaboradores e produtos na farmácia;
  3. Propagar com a equipe boas práticas de prevenção de perdas;
  4. Realizar monitoramento, como fiscalização de pessoas com atos suspeitos de furtos, roubos e demais delitos.

Requirements And Qualifications

Ensino médio completo.

O que pode ser um diferencial?

Experiência em prevenção de perdas ou como fiscal de loja.

Additional information

Benefícios

  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Plataforma de terapia online;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Process stages

  1. Step 1: Registration
  2. Step 2: Teste Agente de Prevenção de Perdas
  3. Step 3: Entrevista RH
  4. Step 4: Entrevista Gestor
  5. Step 5: Hiring

Vem ser gigante, vem trabalhar na rede de farmácias que é do tamanho do Brasil

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presentes em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE. Por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções , tornamo-nos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . A partir de 2016, implementamos o Clinic Farma, um consultório farmacêutico onde nossos clientes recebem acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: AI Engineering Lead
description:
A little bit about us:

We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.

We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.

We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.

Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.

You can read more about our companyhere and about our team and culturehere . Also, head to our blog for more news about what we’re building and how we work .

About the team:

  • We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack.

  • Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do.

  • We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback.

  • We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.

  • While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up between 3 pm and 6 pm, CEST.

  • Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.

Your opportunity:

  • Shape our AI strategy: Identify, prioritize, and execute on high-impact AI initiatives that accelerate company-wide efficiency and innovation.

  • Engage deeply with the tech: Rapidly build, test, and deploy internal tools and customer-facing features using the latest AI technologies.

  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with product, engineering, operations, and business teams to discover use cases and implement intelligent systems that solve real problems.

  • Bring ideas to life: Lead full-lifecycle development—ideation, prototyping, evaluation, iteration, deployment, and maintenance of AI services.

  • Embrace rapid learning and iteration: Embrace fast-paced cycles, quick experiments

This position may be for you if:

  • You’ve contributed to building and maintaining LLM-powered systems in production settings.

  • You’re comfortable working with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, or PydanticAI and applying them in context.

  • You're familiar with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its design considerations.

  • You integrate AI tools like agents or copilots into your workflow to improve productivity and efficiency.

  • You’re curious about new models and tools, and thoughtful about what’s practical for production use.

  • You bring solid engineering skills in Python (and ideally Django or FastAPI), and care about writing maintainable, well-tested code.

  • You value sharing progress early, collaborating closely with stakeholders, and view learning as an iterative process.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in software engineering or building technical products.

  • You're fluent in English, written and spoken, and can clearly articulate technical decisions to diverse audiences.

Amazing if:

  • Have previous experience in Fintech or SaaS product environments.

  • Have experience building agentic systems that integrate across tools and APIs.

  • Have worked in fast-paced or small-team environments where ownership and adaptability are important.

  • Have experience designing thoughtful evaluation approaches for AI features.

  • Have experience working with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures or vector databases.

Our tech stack:

  • We’re building our platform using modern technologies, putting the focus on reliability and long-term maintainability

  • We primarily use Python on the backend. We use battle-tested technologies such as Django, and we are heavy users of Python’s asyncio for some parts of our stack

  • We use Javascript, Vue.js and Sass on the frontend. We are developing and leveraging our own design system and component library

  • We run our infrastructure on top of Amazon Web Services, leveraging managed services. We tend to favor the use of managed services wherever possible, in order to focus on our business problems

  • We observe and monitor our services using Datadog

  • We follow Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery best practices

Our process steps:

At Belvo every hire is so important to us, that we share the decision to hire as a team.

  • People team chat

  • Take-home challenge

  • Challenge presentation

  • Manager interview

  • Meet the founders

Remote friendly

Pet friendly

Renew your laptop every 3 years

title: Página da Vaga | Banco de Talentos (PCD)
description:
O Grupo Casa do Adubo é capixaba e está no mercado do agronegócio desde 1937. Atualmente está presente com suas empresas em 11 estados brasileiros, levando insumos e soluções para viabilizar o agro brasileiro.

Atuamos em dois grandes segmentos de mercado: Casa do Adubo como revenda de insumos agropecuários ao consumidor final, através de seu amplo time de vendedores externos, com foco no atendimento aos pequenos e médios produtos rurais diretamente em suas propriedades, bem como pela rede de lojas; e Agrodistribuidor Casal como distribuidora atacadista para atender outras revendas de insumos no país.

Atualmente com 35 unidades Casa do Adubo e 10 equipes Agrodistribuidor Casal em operação, são mais de 1.000 colaboradores que atendem agricultores e pecuaristas com unidades físicas e logística própria nos Estados do Espírito Santo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Bahia, Mato Grosso, Rondônia, Acre, Pará, Maranhão e Tocantins.

Mas oh... Nossa expansão não para e daqui a pouco esses números mudam! \O/

Somos uma empresa de pessoas e nossa marca é realizar boas colheitas!

Não encontrou nenhuma oportunidade que se encaixa perfeitamente em seu perfil ou anseios profissionais? Não seja por isso, nós abrimos este canal "Banco de Talentos" para receber seu currículo independente das oportunidades que temos divulgadas para o momento.

Estamos fazendo história no mercado do agronegócio. Venha fazer parte desse time incrível e apaixonado pelo agro!

Casa do Adubo é sucessora de Irmão Chiabai, empresa fundada em 16 de outubro de 1937 por Emílio, Ivo e Raymundo Chiabai, no Município de Afonso Cláudio, para atuar no ramo de secos e molhados, armarinhos, ferragens e tecidos, assim como no comércio de café. Em 1952 a sede foi transferida para Av. República, em Vitória-ES.

A fim de acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos setores agrícola e pecuário do Estado, em 1973, a empresa alterou a razão social para Casa do Adubo Ltda. Estevão Covre assumiu o controle com os seus filhos Nicolau Emílio Covre e João Bosco Covre, dando um novo direcionamento aos negócios.

As atividades na área rural cresceram e os proprietários decidiram investir em novas unidades, inaugurando a primeira filial, em 1977,no Município de Cariacica, onde está a Administração Central. Neste mesmo ano José Carlos Bento entra para a sociedade.

A Casa do Adubo está migrando sua plataforma de recrutamento. Para conferir as vagas ativas e se candidatar, acesse nosso novo portal de carreiras: Casa do Adubo

title: Portfolio Analyst
description:
Descrição da empresa

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in the city of Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft signed the purchase of Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of the Spanish company Elecnor, which includes nine operational wind farms in the states of Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. Thus, the company became one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing the mark of 2.2 GW of installed capacity, including acquisitions, constructions, and operations in the country.

The company is a pioneer in offering traceable renewable energy with a guarantee of origin in Brazil, certifying, through the I-REC (International Renewable Energy Certificate), the origin of its energy production, ensuring that the operation is sustainable.

Descrição do emprego

We are looking for someone who can lead the development and the implementation of portfolio tools for the Asset book, andsupport and propose commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, taking into consideration the expansion of the asset fleet (greenfield and M&A projects) also as R2M opportunities.

As parte of this role, you will also:

  • Develop, improve and maintain the modelling of portfolio tools for the Asset book;
  • Propose and assess commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, focusing on long-term value creation and risk mitigation aspects;
  • Support Energy Management team on suggesting commercial strategies for maturities up to Y+5;
  • Assess the impact of Greenfield and M&A projects on the asset portfolio, including base case and sensitivities scenarios;
  • Support BD and M&A teams on the related processes;
  • Estimate the impact of R2M opportunities (LT PPAs, self-productions, etc) on the asset portfolio, taking into consideration updated market inputs from commercial teams (Trading and Origination);
  • Liaise closely with the risk department on P&L estimations and risk measurement for the Assets portfolio.

Qualificações

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economy or Business Administration;
  • Post Graduation in engineering or economics;
  • Solid experience in the electricity sector in Brazil;
  • Experience in portfolio management;
  • Knowledge in Risk Analysis and R / Python coding;
  • Fluent English and Portuguese.

title: Coordenador de Supply Chain, Varejo
description:
Job ID: 3002906 | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras e é uma posição de pessoa contribuidora individual.
A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. No Brasil , estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes pois entendemos que essa agenda precisa de diferentes perspectivas e vivências múltiplas. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos príncipios de liderança, com objetivo de sermos “a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo”. Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que “ Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades”. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI. Além disso, atuam como embaixadores dessa agenda e vão te apoiar desde o Day 1. Lembre-se “ it´s always Day 1”. Os grupos estão organizados nas seguintes frentes: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e Pessoa com Deficiência.
Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) é um serviço que visa ajudar marcas e parceiros estratégicos a se desenvolverem de maneira sustentável com a Amazon. AVS ajuda os paceiros na Amazon a crescer de maneira sustentável, além de aumentar a disponibilidade e a descoberta de seus produtos. A Equipe de Especialistas Supply Chain é especializada em ajudar parceiros com desafios operacionais a alinhar melhor seus processos logísticos com a Amazon, analisar problemas de cadeia de suprimentos e desenvolver soluções sustentáveis para evitar perdas financeiras e trazer a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.Nesta posição, você reportará ao líder de gestão de operações de categoria e trabalhará para construir a estratégia de Supply Chain de contas chave. Você será responsável por liderar o planejamento de previsão de estoque, execução de compras e melhoria operacional de projetos, atuando como ponto de contato chave para gestão de estoque para um segmento de fornecedores. Você irá trabalhar na identificação de oportunidades de simplificar e automatizar tarefas, garantindo que sistemas e processos de inventário atendem às necessidades do negócio, implementando controles sobre estes. A pessoa ideal terá energia para lidar com ambiente em que atividades táticas e estratégicas acontecerão paralelamente.
Nesta posição, você irá gerenciar fornecedores de alta complexidade, trabalhando com autonomia para entregar o serviço. Você também será responsável por projetos de médio a alto impacto, atingindo especialistas de Supply Chain AVS em várias categorias de produtos e implementando melhorias de processos escaláveis para todo o varejo da Amazon.
Key job responsibilities
- Análise da operação de supply chain utilizando dados e identificando as causas dos problemas operacionais (giro de estoque, lead time, reabastecimento, taxa de confirmação, forecast);
- Definição de planos de ação conjunta com os parceiros para eliminar defeitos de Supply Chain e fazer revisões regulares de progresso com fornecedores para criar resultados sustentáveis de longo prazo;
- Cooperar e construir um relacionamento de confiança em todas as funções e níveis de trabalho dentro da organização do parceiro (por exemplo, gerente de contas chave, gerente de Supply Chain, gerente de atendimento ao cliente), bem como na Amazon (Vendor Managers - gerentes comerciais, especialistas de contas chave, InStock Managers - gerentes de Supply Chain, gerentes de produto/programa, Equipes de Operações);
- Preparação de revisões regulares de progresso para implementar soluções sustentáveis e resultados de longo prazo;
- Organização e gestão de projetos com fornecedores sobre melhoria contínua/Kaizens;
- Desenvolvimento de projetos internos para desenvolver ainda mais o programa AVS (por exemplo, planejamento de recursos, comunicação interna e externa, criação de mecanismos para soluções de problemas de toda a população de fornecedores, automação de relatórios etc.)

- Bacharel/Licenciatura (engenharia, administração ou áreas relacionadas à operações/cadeia de suprimento/logística);
- Forte habilidade analítica, afinidade com números e habilidade de resolução de problemas;
- Alto nível de auto-organização, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo;
- Experiência sólida em gestão de produto/categoria, planejamento comercial, logística, gestão da cadeia e/ou de suprimentos;
- Comunicação escrita e verbal em inglês avançada;
- Experiência com gerenciamento de público sênior e influência de pessoas.

- Experiência com SQL;
- Experiência com painéis de dados (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, QlikSense);
- Experiência com Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen;
- Experiência com gerencimento de pessoas;
- Experiência com análise financeira/qualitativa

title: Operador(a) de Logística
description:
O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência em recebimento, conferência, separação e movimentação de mercadorias.
  • Experiência no sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.
  • Desejável habilidade na administração de prioridades.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado, prática e permanente respeito aos procedimentos, normas e regras da empresa.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana e feriados.
  • Orientação para a satisfação do cliente.

Como é o dia a dia de um(a) Operador(a) de Logística:

  • RECEPÇÃO DE MERCADORIAS:
    • Realiza a recepção quantitativa e qualitativa das mercadorias comercializadas e não comercializadas (equipamentos, materiais de escritório, etc), verificando e identificando o estado geral, fornecedor, metragem, referência, tonalidade, prazo de validade, etc.
    • Prepara o espaço físico e equipamentos necessários para a correta recepção, evitando a perda de produtividade na conferência.
    • Anota sobre o relatório de conferência tudo o que for relativo às mercadorias recebidas (quantidades, estado aparente, validades, etc), assegurando qualidade e prevenindo perdas.
    • Armazena as mercadorias no endereço de depósito correto, através da leitura da ficha da recepção buscando agilizar as futuras montagens dos pedidos de retira ou de entrega.
    • Etiqueta os produtos com código de barra ausente ou defeituoso e inserir as etiquetas de segurança nos produtos sensíveis a furtos, assegurando que as mercadorias entregues ao comércio estejam disponíveis para venda.
    • Separa as mercadorias seguindo a tipologia dos fluxos quanto a mercadorias de loja ou do depósito.
    • Libera as mercadorias para a armazenagem na Loja ou no Depósito, contatando a equipe de Reposição ou a de Armazenamento para efetuar a armazenagem (Cautela).
    • Realiza ações anti-demarcas através da checagem qualitativa e quantitativa rigorosa sobre as mercadorias recepcionadas, através de um bom fluxo de veículos no pátio da Recepção de Mercadorias e do correto manuseio dos equipamentos de movimentação (paleteiras, "gaiolas", etc).
    • Mantém organizado os equipamentos, ferramentas de trabalho e EPI’s (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual).
    • Realiza o empilhamento seguro dos paletes evitando prejuízos à bens e pessoas.
    • Mantém a área de recepção limpa e organizada ajudando a combater a demarca e prevenindo acidentes no trabalho.
    • Recebe as demarcas validadas pelo Comércio realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e colocando o produto demarcado no local de despejo.
    • Recebe as devoluções aos fornecedores, validadas pelo Comércio, realizando as conferências quali-quantitativas e agendando a coleta.
    • Recebe as remessas para Assistência Técnica, realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e agendando a coleta.
  • RETIRADA E ENTREGA EM DOMICÍLIO:
    • Efetua a separação do RSS (reserva sobre estoque), identificando os produtos e informando a separação para o setor comercial.
    • Realiza o endereçamento das mercadorias fazendo a reserva física de espaço e inventário rotativo com base na listagem dos produtos de RSS.
    • Efetua a entrega das mercadorias ao cliente, de forma ágil e cordial, colocando-as no veículo do cliente.
    • Separa e confere as mercadorias verificando todos os itens descritos no pedido emitido, disponibilizando-as para entrega a clientes no setor de retirada de mercadorias ou para transportadora (entrega em domicilio).
  • REPOSIÇÃO:
    • Repõe os produtos na loja de forma adequada.
  • GESTÃO DO ESTOQUE:
    • Armazena e garante a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos estoques.
    • Verifica diariamente os pedidos gerados pela área comercial, analisa a consistência de dados necessários no pedido (endereços, telefones, data entrega, referência, disponibilidade, etc), organizando a separação cronológica dos pedidos e liberando-os para faturamento.
    • Efetua atendimento telefônico informando os clientes sobre prazos de entrega.
    • Informa o Supervisor de Logística sobre eventuais problemas que envolvem a equipe de separação, operação e produtos.
    • Auxilia o Supervisor de Logística para o bom andamento dos endereçamentos do depósito (set-up, inventários rotativos, etc).
    • Efetua o tratamento diário dos pedidos cancelados de RSS.
    • Efetua o registro referente a demarcas de mercadorias apontadas na separação de mercadorias.
    • Tem bom relacionamento e atua como elo de contato com a transportadora terceirizada.
    • Juntamente com a equipe de SAC realiza o trabalho preventivo de possíveis problemas com mercadorias.
    • Informa ao Supervisor de Logística e/ou ao Gerente de Logística sobre eventuais ocorrências de problemas com mercadorias.
    • É referência no atendimento do Balcão de Retirada de Mercadorias.
    • É responsável pelos seus equipamentos de trabalho.
    • Respeita as normas de segurança.

Candidate-se para esta vaga e faça parte da nossa construção!

Desejamos boa sorte no seu processo!

Não deixe de visitar uma loja e conhecer ainda mais sobre como é fazer parte do nosso time, vendo de perto as pessoas que entregam as melhores experiências para nossos clientes.

Incentivamos a diversidade e a inclusão, por isso, todas as vagas estão disponíveis para Pessoas com Deficiências (PcD).

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

A Estoca é uma empresa de logística movida por tecnologia, proporcionando uma experiência mais rápida, operação com baixa fricção e maior visibilidade para os e-commerces.

title: Advogado Especialista em Garantias - Pleno/Sênior
description:
Resumo da Posição

O Advogado de Garantias é responsável pela análise, estruturação e formalização de garantias em operações financeiras e empresariais, garantindo conformidade com normas regulatórias e segurança jurídica para credores e investidores.

Atua na elaboração e revisão de contratos, acompanhamento de execuções de garantias e mitigação de riscos jurídicos associados a financiamentos e investimentos.

Principais Responsabilidades :

· Elaborar, revisar e negociar instrumentos de garantias reais e pessoais, como hipotecas, alienação fiduciária, penhor e fianças;

· Analisar a viabilidade jurídica das garantias em operações de crédito;

· Acompanhar a regularização e registro de garantias perante cartórios, juntas comerciais e órgãos competentes;

· Garantir a conformidade com normas regulatórias, como BACEN, CVM e demais legislações aplicáveis;

· Atuar na mitigação de riscos legais em operações estruturadas e contratos de garantia;

· Prestar suporte jurídico em execuções de garantias, recuperações de crédito e disputas contratuais;

· Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas como crédito, jurídico, compliance e financeiro para assegurar a eficácia dos instrumentos de garantia;

· Monitorar mudanças regulatórias e propor atualizações nos processos de garantias da empresa;

· Participar de negociações estratégicas envolvendo garantias e estruturação de operações financeiras.

Requisitos :

· Formação superior em Direito com OAB ativa;

· Experiência sólida em garantias reais e pessoais, direito contratual, regulatório, FIDCs e financeiras;

· Conhecimento da legislação aplicável a financiamentos, mercado de capitais e operações estruturadas;

· Habilidade de negociação e análise jurídica detalhada de contratos;

· Capacidade de interpretar normativas do Banco Central, CVM e órgãos reguladores;

· Inglês avançado é um diferencial;

· Pós-graduação ou certificação em direito bancário, mercado financeiro ou áreas correlatas são diferenciais.

Soft Skill

· Pensamento Analítico – Essencial para interpretar contratos, normativas regulatórias e avaliar riscos jurídicos nas operações de garantia;

· Atenção aos Detalhes – Fundamental para revisar documentos, identificar cláusulas críticas e evitar falhas que possam comprometer a validade da garantia;

· Habilidade de Negociação – Importante para estruturar garantias e negociar termos contratuais favoráveis junto a credores, investidores e instituições financeiras;

· Comunicação Clara e Objetiva – Necessário para redigir contratos, elaborar pareceres e interagir com diferentes áreas da empresa de forma assertiva;

· Resolução de Problemas – Capacidade de encontrar soluções eficientes para impasses jurídicos em garantias e execuções de crédito;

· Tomada de Decisão Estratégica – Importante para avaliar riscos e propor estruturas de garantia seguras e juridicamente viáveis;

· Organização e Gestão do Tempo – Essencial para lidar com múltiplos contratos, prazos de registros e execuções de garantias;

· Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração – Necessário para atuar em conjunto com as áreas de crédito, jurídico, compliance e financeiro;

· Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade – Importante para acompanhar mudanças regulatórias e adaptar processos conforme novas exigências do mercado;

· Ética e Discrição – Indispensável para lidar com informações sensíveis e garantir a integridade na análise e execução de garantias.

description:
Aboute the role:

We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Analyst to manage Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts, ensuring the best experience and results for our strategic clients. You will be the main point of contact, acting as a business partner focused on onboarding, engagement, expansion, and retention.

Responsibilities:

  • Onboarding and Training: Lead the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring efficient implementation and comprehensive training for client teams.

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related areas, preferably in technology, SaaS, Telecom, or CPaaS companies.
  • Experience with Mid-Market and/or Enterprise clients.
  • Proven skills in project management, organization, and prioritization.
  • Experience conducting QBRs/EBRs and executive presentations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
  • Familiarity with CRMs, especially Salesforce.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage different stakeholders.
  • Collaborative, proactive, resilient, and results-oriented profile.
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and focus on delivering excellent customer service.
