  • Programar, acompanhar e executar sondagens prospectivas e de detalhe, com foco na cubagem de reservas minerais.
  • Reportar resultados estratégicos para a Coordenação Geral, Gerência e Diretoria da área de Exploração.
  • Participar da elaboração de relatórios técnicos exigidos por órgãos como a ANM (Agência Nacional de Mineração), além de relatórios internos mensais.
  • Revisar documentos e entregas das equipes de exploração, garantindo a qualidade técnica dos dados e produtos gerados.
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, a geologia de curto prazo das operações, atuando em interface direta com as equipes de geologia de mina e planejamento.

Formação em Geologia/ Engenharia geológica

Experiência consolidada com experiência superior a 10 anos aplicados à exploração e pesquisa mineral.

Domínio das melhores técnicas de pesquisa para diferentes tipos de commodities, principalmente minério de ferro.

Conhecimento em técnicas modernas de amostragem geoquímica, métodos geofísicos e sondagens.

Experiência em gestão de projetos, com foco em cronogramas, prazos e controle de custos.

Habilidade no processamento de dados geoquímicos, petrológicos e estatísticos aplicados à prospecção mineral.

Vivência em pesquisa geológica em ambientes greenfield , brownfield e em operações de mina.

Interpretação de dados geológicos em ambientes tridimensionais (3D).

Experiência com estimativa de recursos minerais por meio de softwares especializados (ex.: Leapfrog, Micromine, Datamine).

Conhecimento na elaboração de relatórios técnicos exigidos por órgãos reguladores, como a ANM.

Grupo EP Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Estamos Muito Felizes Com o Seu Interesse Em Embarcar Em Uma Jornada Com Propósito Na EP. Antes De Tudo, Queremos Que Você Conheça Um Pouco Mais Sobre Quem Somos e o Impacto Que Geramos
Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade , atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.
Com mais de 50 anos de existência, estamos entre as 5 maiores empresas em tratamento de água e análises ambientais no país.
Já ajudamos nossos clientes a tratarem mais de 700 milhões de m³ de efluentes — o equivalente ao consumo anual de água de 12 milhões de pessoas (toda a população do Estado de SP).
Contamos com mais de 500 colaboradores , atuando em 5 frentes especializadas : Analítica, Engenharia, Equipamentos, Química e Tech.
Nosso objetivo é claro: expandir nossa atuação em todo o Brasil até 2033 .

Aqui, a coerência entre discurso e prática é essencial. Transparência, ética e responsabilidade norteiam nosso relacionamento com clientes, parceiros e colegas.
Visto a camisa
Estamos em busca de pessoas comprometidas, que se conectem com nosso propósito e tenham orgulho de fazer parte dessa transformação ambiental.
Hoje melhor que ontem
Acreditamos no poder da melhoria contínua. Pequenas evoluções diárias nos tornam uma empresa melhor e mais relevante para o mundo.
Se você também é #MOVIDOAAGUA e deseja fazer a diferença com o seu trabalho, vem com a gente!
Missão do cargo: As operações terceirizadas tem como responsabilidade garantir o perfeito funcionamento das estações de tratamento do nosso cliente, a fim de não poluir o meio ambiente, atendendo as legislações ambientais e oferecendo água de qualidade para uso em processos internos, quando necessário.
Como Será Seu Dia a Dia
Atuar na área operacional de estações de tratamentos de água e efluentes (industriais e domésticos) e reuso de água, mantendo em perfeito funcionamento;
Realizar monitoramento dos volumes dos tanques;
Realizar leitura de temperatura, pH, turbidez, Resíduos Sedimentáveis e Sedimentabilidade do lodo, de acordo com os procedimentos internos;
Preparar e repor produtos químicos inerentes ao processo de tratamento;
Preencher planilhas de controle – trabalho diário e controle de qualidade;
Verificar indicadores de funcionamento;

Realizar coleta de amostras para análise em laboratório;
Realizar análises químicas de baixa complexidade;
Prezar pela organização e manutenção do ambiente de trabalho;
Manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.

Curso Técnico em Química, Meio Ambiente ou áreas correlatas;
CRQ ativo;

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth thanks to the support of renowned investors which include Atinum Investment, Tiger Global, Transcend Capital and Gobi Partners. Prior Experience in Saas/ Software Industry is preferred

Role

We are looking for an ambitious Growth Partnership Executive to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you will build and manage prospect relationships to drive revenue for SleekFlow. A vital part of this opportunity is partnering with the Customer Success and Product team to ensure the quality and quantity of sales pipeline.

  • Handle our sales conversion process for Small & Medium Businesses

  • Strong and demonstrated written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Sales Methodology training preferred.
  • CRM (e.g. Hubspot) & marketing experience preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment.

  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.

title: Account Manager
description:
Description

As part of Willis Towers Watson’s Captive Solutions team, the Account Manager plays a key role in delivering tailored management services to a portfolio of captive insurance companies. Captive Solutions spans multiple business segments—including Corporate Risk and Broking (CRB), Human Capital and Benefits (HCB), and Investment, Risk and Reinsurance (IRR)—and offers clients innovative, data-driven approaches to risk financing.

This role supports the strategic and operational performance of client captives through active engagement in underwriting, regulatory compliance, financial management, and governance. The Account Manager collaborates closely with internal experts—including actuaries, risk consultants, accountants, and brokers—as well as with external stakeholders such as clients, regulators, and service providers.

With no two captives alike, the Account Manager must bring flexibility, analytical insight, and client-focused problem-solving to help structure and manage bespoke captive solutions. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a team that combines industry-leading analytics, strategic consultancy, and operational excellence to deliver clarity and value to our clients.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

Ensures strong relationships with client, regulators, captive directors and key service providers.

Works as part of the Client Service Team, as well as interacts with clients, prospects, regulators and external service providers.

Insurance

  • Liaison with insurance broker and reinsurance brokers as required.
  • Assist with underwriting decisions in conjunction with the Client Service Team and the Practice Underwriting resources, as appropriate.
  • Monitoring of exposures and risk transfer pricing within assigned portfolio.
  • Assist with regulatory approval for changes to the business plan.
  • Assist with Board approval for underwriting decisions.

Finance/Regulatory

  • Monitoring of domicile solvency and capital requirements
  • Obtaining regulatory approval of changes to business plan
  • Obtaining board approval for underwriting decisions Accounting for premium Agree reserving methodology
  • Ensure the production of management accounts, statutory accounts and information, budgets, cash flow statements and supplementary information as required.
  • Assist with the adoption of appropriate accounting practices and ensure adherence thereto.
  • Manage cash requirements of the companies Liaise with and monitor investment managers in respect of invested funds
  • Assist Client Service Team with co-ordination of board meetings
  • Ensure timely production of board papers.
  • Ensure timely production of minutes and review prior to distribution.
  • Action matters arising from client meetings
  • Ensure relevant company secretarial functions are performed in a timely manner.
  • Ensure compliance with Corporate Governance.

Management

  • To participate in and provide input on strategic and major operational issues.
  • Assume responsibility for a specific area of company strategy.
  • To implement policies adopted by the Practice Contact is maintained with all client directors and that they are advised of any developments.
  • Keep Practice leadership apprised of client developments.
  • Entertain clients & prospects as required.
  • Support Senior Executive in performing board insight, perspective & thought leadership as required
  • Understands importance of Internal Control procedures and the WTW code of Conduct and works to be seen as a role model in the office.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • 2-4 year degree in Accounting, Finance or related area
  • Computer Skills
  • A plus, but not required is knowledge and experience of captive insurance and insurance industry in the following areas: (1) accounting for captives (2) insurance products, and (3) problem resolution
  • Willis Towers Watson knowledge (platforms, structure, etc.)
  • Ability to monitor quality control Client relationship skills
  • Project Management skills

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.
Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation.

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $70,000-$100,000 USDper year.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (Washington State only )
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k).

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

We understand flexibility is key to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce and so we encourage requests for all types of flexible working as well as location-based arrangements. Please speak to your recruiter to discuss more.

About The Team/Role
We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive Information Security GRC Analyst Level 3 – PCI DSS Compliance to support our organization’s PCI DSS compliance efforts. This role will focus on ensuring strict adherence to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) while contributing to broader governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in PCI DSS and the ability to drive compliance programs in complex environments.

About The Team/Role
We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive Information Security GRC Analyst Level 3 – PCI DSS Compliance to support our organization’s PCI DSS compliance efforts. This role will focus on ensuring strict adherence to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) while contributing to broader governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in PCI DSS and the ability to drive compliance programs in complex environments.
How You'll Make An Impact
Participate and play a key role in the WEX PCI DSS compliance program, ensuring ongoing adherence to the latest PCI DSS requirements.

  • Conduct and coordinate PCI DSS gap assessments, control evaluations, and risk assessments to identify and remediate deficiencies.
  • Conduct and coordinate PCI DSS annual reviews in accordance with PCI DSS v4.0.1.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for external audits, working closely with Qualified Security Assessors (QSAs), auditors, and regulatory bodies to ensure successful compliance certifications.
  • Develop and maintain PCI DSS policies, procedures, and documentation to align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with IT, Security, Legal, and Business teams to integrate PCI DSS controls into enterprise security and risk management frameworks.
  • Implement security and compliance automation tools to enhance PCI DSS control effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Stay updated on PCI DSS regulatory changes and evolving threats, advising on necessary adjustments.
  • Support broader GRC initiatives, including ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, and risk management programs, as needed.
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for PCI DSS, advising stakeholders on compliance strategies, risks, and security best practices.
Experience You'll Bring
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Experience in information security, compliance, risk management, or a related field, with a strong focus on PCI DSS compliance. Experience with PCI issuing banks preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: In-depth understanding of PCI DSS, security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2), risk management methodologies, cloud environments (AWS and Azure), and secure network architectures.
  • Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills; ability to communicate effectively with both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Tools & Technologies: Experience with GRC tools, security compliance platforms, vulnerability management tools, and cloud security.
  • Certifications (Preferred): PCI Professional (PCIP), Qualified Security Assessor (QSA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).

About Us

Zurich Insurance Company is a leading provider of insurance products and services, committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer service. Our ZCAM (Zurich Customer Active Management) team turns customer data into practical business solutions to drive the implementation of our ambitious customer strategy.

If you are a talented, dynamic and experienced Data Analyst, passionate about connecting the dots and have a strong background in technology, we would love to hear from you.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work with us.

The opportunity: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

As a Business Analyst, you will help ZCAM’s customers by understanding their needs and developing solutions to business problems. You will work with multidisciplinary and international teams to gather requirements, document processes, and communicate findings. Your responsibilities will include collecting and documenting business needs, analyzing data to identify trends and insights, suggesting process improvements, creating reports and presentations for stakeholders, and collaborating with teams to implement solutions. Additionally, you will be key to ensure that project objectives align with business goals, and will lead meetings and workshops to drive project success. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Understands customers objectives, processes and products in order to make appropriate recommendations for customer-specific needs during incubation, delivery and operations
  • Plans, conducts and facilitates incubation sessions for business requirements gathering with subject matter experts and end users ensuring deliverables are met
  • Adapts and applies different delivery methodologies determining the best methodology for the specific project
  • Contributes to business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Produces requirement specifications and outlines solution design documents throughout the project life cycle, incorporating change requests and finalization of requirements documentation
  • Analyzes and manages requirement risk, traceability matrix and prioritizes requirements
  • Performs quality review checks on project deliverables
  • Participates in development of test plan, testing, implementation and training activities
  • Participates in post implementation activities including problem solving and measurement of benefits achieved
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels
  • Creates compelling project documents such as business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Manages interdependencies within the projects and other functions
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or science or a related field, any higher degree is an advantage
  • Professional experience in related role and/or demonstrated competency (projects) utilizing relevant technologies
  • Balanced mix of business acumen as well as affinity to technology and systems
  • Innovative and creative self-starter, highly motivated, business and IT savvy
  • Independent and able to handle multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Must possess in-depth, strong problem-solving analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Experience in the delivery of business solutions in time, quality, and budget
  • Proven experience as business analyst or subject matter expert in global projects and/or sound knowledge in insurance business
  • Proven track with project management & software development methodologies (e.g. Agile, SCRUM, ITIL, PMP)
  • Tough-minded, highly flexible and determine to deliver assigned targets
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Experience in application testing and organizing user acceptance testing
  • Customer-oriented team player with good communication abilities, fostering effective collaboration and teamwork
  • Strong proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required, Spanish language skills are a plus.

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich wants to attract the best talent and we acknowledge that talents might not always be available full-time. At Zurich we will consider requests for flexible working. Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of ways. Please talk to us during the interview about the flexibility you may need.

A Little Bit About Us
We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.
We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.
We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.
Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.
You can read more about our company here and about our team and culture here. Also, head to our blog for more news about what we’re building and how we work.
About The Team

  • We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack.
  • Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do.
  • We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback.
  • We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.
  • While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up between 3 pm and 6 pm, CEST.
  • Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.
Your Opportunity
  • Shape our AI strategy: Identify, prioritize, and execute on high-impact AI initiatives that accelerate company-wide efficiency and innovation.
  • Engage deeply with the tech: Rapidly build, test, and deploy internal tools and customer-facing features using the latest AI technologies.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with product, engineering, operations, and business teams to discover use cases and implement intelligent systems that solve real problems.
  • Bring ideas to life: Lead full-lifecycle development—ideation, prototyping, evaluation, iteration, deployment, and maintenance of AI services.
  • Embrace rapid learning and iteration: Embrace fast-paced cycles, quick experiments
This Position May Be For You If
  • You’ve contributed to building and maintaining LLM-powered systems in production settings.
  • You’re comfortable working with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, or PydanticAI and applying them in context.
  • You're familiar with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its design considerations.
  • You integrate AI tools like agents or copilots into your workflow to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • You’re curious about new models and tools, and thoughtful about what’s practical for production use.
  • You bring solid engineering skills in Python (and ideally Django or FastAPI), and care about writing maintainable, well-tested code.
  • You value sharing progress early, collaborating closely with stakeholders, and view learning as an iterative process.
  • You bring 5+ years of experience in software engineering or building technical products.
  • You're fluent in English, written and spoken, and can clearly articulate technical decisions to diverse audiences.
Amazing If
  • Have previous experience in Fintech or SaaS product environments.
  • Have experience building agentic systems that integrate across tools and APIs.
  • Have worked in fast-paced or small-team environments where ownership and adaptability are important.
  • Have experience designing thoughtful evaluation approaches for AI features.
  • Have experience working with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures or vector databases.
Our Tech Stack
  • We’re building our platform using modern technologies, putting the focus on reliability and long-term maintainability

title: Product Manager - Plataforma de Crédito
description:
Há 10 anos, desafiamos o mercado financeiro com soluções acessíveis e inovadoras. Aprovamos até 2x mais que outros players, com tecnologia que combina mais de 400 fatores para oferecer crédito rápido e sem complicação, usando só CPF e celular.
No Jeitto, dar um jeito é pra hoje. Temos urgência porque nosso cliente tem urgência. É por isso que buscamos, todo dia, dar um jeito pra que quem faz muito com pouco continue fazendo mais e melhor sempre.
A área de Core Crédito é o coração tecnológico do nosso negócio. Ela é responsável por construir e evoluir a infraestrutura central, os motores e os serviços que permitem à Jeitto criar, lançar e operar todos os produtos de crédito de forma rápida, escalável e segura. Somos o alicerce que habilita a inovação e o crescimento de todas as outras squads de produto.
A posição de Product Manager da Plataforma de Crédito é responsável por definir a visão e o roadmap da espinha dorsal do nosso sistema de crédito. No dia a dia, você irá traduzir a estratégia de negócio em capacidades de plataforma, colaborar intensamente com arquitetos e engenheiros para desenhar soluções robustas e interagir com os PMs de produto final para garantir que eles tenham as ferramentas certas para inovar. Seu impacto é direto na agilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência de toda a operação de crédito do Jeitto.
Este não é um desafio sobre gerenciar um produto, mas sobre construir o motor que impulsiona todos os nossos produtos de crédito. Você terá a oportunidade única de resolver problemas complexos na base do nosso negócio, impactando não apenas um, mas múltiplos produtos simultaneamente.
Os principais atrativos são:

Supergasbras is part of the Dutch group SHV Energy, a global leader in Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) distribution with over 100 years of experience. Being diverse is being Super!

Responsible for the production of LPG bottling in P13 / P20 / P45 packages, logistics for serving resellers and bulk customers across DF and surroundings, industrial maintenance of the bottling unit, QSMS of the unit, LEAN and people management of a team of 100 employees.

  • Train production team for safe and effective operation.

  • Support quality department in handling non-conformities related to the production process.
  • Conduct operational and alignment meetings with logistics, maintenance, quality, and safety teams.

Requirements and Qualifications

Mandatory Requirements

  • Complete higher education in Mechanical, Electronic, Civil, Electrical, Aerospace, or Production Engineering.

Desirable Requirements

  • Knowledge of Power BI.

  • Development: Corporate University and Learning programs.
  • Celebrations: Birthday leave.
  • Other Benefits: Exclusive perks.

We value people and everything they bring: ideas, contribution, partnership, and collaboration. As part of the SHV Energy Group, a global LPG distributor and one of Brazil's leading gas companies with over 75 years of experience, we operate the most modern bottling plant in Latin America and have over 20 industrial units nationwide. title: Payment Success Manager
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

The Financial Institution Business Development (FIBD) team focused on payments plays a critical role in shaping and managing strategic partnerships with banks, payment providers, and other financial stakeholders. Our mission is to enhance the company’s payment capabilities, ensuring a seamless, secure, and efficient transaction experience for our customers across multiple business units, including ride-hailing and 99Pay.

As part of the online payments vertical, we work closely with acquirers, issuers, card schemes, and alternative payment providers to optimize payment operations, expand local payment acceptance, reduce costs, and drive innovation. Collaboration with internal stakeholders—such as risk, compliance, legal, treasury, and product teams—is key to ensuring regulatory compliance and continuous improvement of our payment ecosystem.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the rapidly evolving payments landscape, working on high-impact projects that drive financial efficiency and enhance the user experience.

Role Responsibilities

  • Own and lead initiatives to improve payment success rates, optimize transaction flows, and enhance operational resilience across various payment methods (e.g., cards, PIX, and alternative payments).
  • Act as the subject matter expert on payment performance, working cross-functionally with product, risk, legal, compliance, and treasury teams to identify and implement improvements.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, analyze trends, and use data to inform decisions and advocate for changes that enhance user experience and business outcomes.
  • Manage relationships with external payment service providers, acquiring banks, and card schemes—ensuring alignment on strategic priorities, issue resolution, and future roadmap collaboration.
  • Stay ahead of regulatory changes, payment industry trends, and technology developments, ensuring our systems and strategies remain compliant and competitive.
  • Drive the integration of new payment solutions and enhancements, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, and testing requirements for smooth implementation.

Role Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in payments, fintech, financial operations, or a related area, with demonstrated experience leading projects or initiatives.
  • Desirable: Previous experience in the card benefits market in Brazil — particularly with meal and grocery vouchers—including familiarity with key players, regulatory frameworks, commercial and operational models.
  • A data-driven mindset and strong analytical skills, with the ability to draw insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable strategies.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—comfortable engaging with internal teams and external partners across regions (English proficiency required).
  • A self-starter attitude with the ability to work independently, make informed decisions, and drive projects forward in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility to work across time zones, especially Brazil and China, as part of a global team.

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ADMINISTRATION

What We Do

Our Administrative team plays a key role in Epic's success by providing administrative, scheduling, organizational support, and more to our senior leadership.

What You'll Do

Epic Games seeks an Executive Assistant to support senior leadership at our Brazil studio

In this role, you will

  • Be a strategic member of the team by staying on top of team priorities and proactively engaging in ways to help the team and its leadership meet objectives
  • Facilitate calendar management and meeting scheduling
  • Book travel arrangements, including flights, hotels, trains, ground transportation, and Visas
  • Organize offsite meetings with both internal employees and external partners
  • Submit and reconcile expense reports
  • Provide general support to visitors, including booking conference rooms, organizing catering, completing NDAs, compiling agendas, and scheduling meetings

What we're looking for

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, both written and spoken
  • Proven experience as an executive assistant supporting leadership at the VP level or above
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to multitask and prioritize work
  • Somebody who can move quickly and solve problems autonomously, while paying attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Able to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, quickly changing environment
  • Ability to plan complex and fast-paced travel domestically and internationally
  • Proficient in Excel, Word, and calendaring software
  • Experience working in gaming, entertainment, technology, or communications fields is preferred
  • College degree, preferred

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: ANALISTA JÚNIOR DE CONTROLE DA QUALIDADE MICROBIOLOGIA
description:
Job description

Quer atuar no setor farmacêutico em uma empresa inovadora e em expansão? A Farmarin é referência em nefrologia desde 1988 e pioneira na produção de Concentrados Polieletrolíticos para Hemodiálise no Brasil. Com fábrica em Guarulhos e parte do grupo Medifarma S.A. , investimos em tecnologia, infraestrutura e profissionais qualificados. Nosso portfólio inclui soluções hospitalares e farmacêuticas para o mercado nacional e internacional.

Profissional será responsável por apoiar as atividades do laboratório de microbiologia, contribuindo com as rotinas analíticas e garantindo a conformidade com as Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF), normas regulatórias e procedimentos internos.

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que transforma desafios em oportunidades de crescimento!


Main responsibilities

  • Executar análises microbiológicas de matérias-primas, produtos intermediários, produtos acabados (estéreis e não estéreis), água para injetáveis, água potável, vapor puro, ar comprimido, ambiente e utilidades.
  • Realizar ensaios de Contagem de Micro-organismos Totais, Pesquisa de Patógenos, Testes de Esterilidade, Endotoxinas Bacterianas (LAL), Monitoramento ambiental, entre outros conforme procedimentos internos e farmacopeias.
  • Preparar meios de cultura, soluções e materiais necessários para os ensaios microbiológicos.
  • Executar o monitoramento ambiental de áreas classificadas (partículas viáveis, superfícies, ar e colaboradores).
  • Auxiliar na execução de qualificação de meios de cultura (fertilidade, esterilidade, seletividade).
  • Conduzir atividades de sanitização e controle de insumos e materiais no laboratório.
  • Registrar e revisar dados analíticos de forma clara, objetiva e conforme os requisitos de Data Integrity.
  • Participar de investigações de desvios, OOS, OOT e não conformidades quando aplicável.
  • Manter a organização, limpeza e controle dos materiais e equipamentos do laboratório.
  • Cumprir com as normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.
  • Apoiar validações e estudos de monitoramento microbiológico, validação de limpeza e validação de processo.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Farmácia, Biomedicina, Biologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia: Desejável experiência ou estágio em laboratório microbiológico, preferencialmente na indústria farmacêutica ou em ambiente regulado.
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis:
  • Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF)
  • Farmacopeias (USP, EP, Farmacopéia Brasileira ou outras)
  • Noções de controle microbiológico em produtos estéreis
  • Pacote Office (nível básico a intermediário)

Additional information

  • Benefícios: Assistência Médica Amil, Odontológica Amil, Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Seguro de vida, Vale transporte, Convênio Farmácia, Auxílio Educação após 1 ano de empresa.

Eles trabalham em conjunto com as equipes de design, engenharia e marketing para coordenar o desenvolvimento de forma eficaz.   • Utilizar dados e análises para tomar decisões informadas, medir resultados e iterar constantemente;
  • Explorar e propor o uso de Inteligência Artificial para resolver dores reais dos usuários e/ou escalar processos internos;
  • Influenciar stakeholders em diferentes níveis, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e clareza na evolução dos produtos.
É indispensável para essa vaga:
  • Experiência sólida (mínimo 3 anos) em gestão de produto digital em empresas de tecnologia;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks como OKRs, discovery contínuo, métricas de produto, JTBD, entre outros;

  • Experiência prática liderando times cross-functional com Design, Engenharia e outras áreas;

  • Perfil curioso, analítico e com foco em resolução de problemas com impacto no negócio.

title: Account Executive - Captive Management
description:
Description

Willis Towers Watson’s Captive Solutions team delivers customized, data-driven insurance management services across Corporate Risk and Broking (CRB), Human Capital and Benefits (HCB), and Investment, Risk and Reinsurance (IRR). As part of this highly specialized group, the Account Executive is responsible for managing a portfolio of captive insurance companies by providing strategic, operational, and financial oversight tailored to each client’s unique risk profile.

Reporting to senior leadership and working closely with clients, regulators, and service providers, the Account Executive plays a critical role in shaping underwriting strategy, ensuring regulatory and financial compliance, and delivering timely, high-quality board and management reporting. The role also contributes to new business development by identifying growth opportunities, supporting marketing initiatives, and offering expert technical guidance.

The ideal candidate brings at least 15 years of experience in captive insurance and financial services, with deep knowledge of insurance accounting, products, and problem resolution. Strong leadership, project management, and client relationship skills are essential, along with the ability to provide strategic insight, influence stakeholders, and uphold the highest standards of compliance and corporate governance.

This position offers a dynamic opportunity to lead within a team of top-tier professionals—actuaries, brokers, analysts, and consultants—dedicated to delivering clarity, innovation, and value to clients through Willis Towers Watson’s world-class Captive Solutions platform.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

New Business

  • To assist in the development of new business for the Company
  • Give input to the creation of a marketing and new business strategy.
  • Implement marketing and new business strategy.
  • Identify new business opportunities (including cross-selling opportunities) within existing client base.
  • Take responsibility for a number of new business development projects.
  • Promote the Company within and outside the Willis Group.
  • To provide technical advice on request within the Practice.

Insurance

  • Liaison with insurance broker and reinsurance brokers as required.
  • Underwriting decisions in conjunction with the Client Service Team and the Practice Underwriting resources, as appropriate.
  • Monitoring of exposures and risk transfer pricing within assigned portfolio.
  • Oversee regulatory approval for changes to the business plan.
  • Oversee Board approval for underwriting decisions.

Finance/Regulatory

  • Monitoring of domicile solvency and capital requirements
  • Obtaining regulatory approval of changes to business plan
  • Obtaining board approval for underwriting decisions
  • Accounting for premium
  • Agree reserving methodology
  • Ensure the production of management accounts, statutory accounts and information, budgets, cash flow statements and supplementary information as required.
  • Assist with the adoption of appropriate accounting practices and ensure adherence thereto.
  • Manage cash requirements of the companies
  • Liaise with and monitor investment managers in respect of invested funds
  • Assist Client Service Team with co-ordination of board meetings
  • Ensure timely production of board papers.
  • Ensure timely production of minutes and review prior to distribution.
  • Action matters arising from client meetings
  • Ensure relevant company secretarial functions are performed in a timely manner.
  • Ensure compliance with Corporate Governance.

Management

  • To participate in and provide input on strategic and major operational issues. Assume responsibility for a specific area of company strategy.
  • To implement policies adopted by the Practice
  • Contact is maintained with all client directors and that they are advised of any developments.
  • Keep Practice leadership apprised of client developments.
  • Entertain clients & prospects as required.
  • Support Senior Principal in performing board insight, perspective & thought leadership as required
  • Understands importance of WEM and the WTW code of Conduct and works to be seen as a role model in the office.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • 4 year degree in Accounting, Finance or related area or CPA qualification
  • Maintenance of CPA qualification through CPD, as appropriate
  • Advanced Computer Skills
  • In depth knowledge and experience of captive insurance and insurance industry (minimum 15 years’ experience) in the following areas: (1) accounting for captives (2) insurance products, and (3) problem resolution
  • Willis Towers Watson knowledge (platforms, structure, etc.)
  • Ability to monitor quality control
  • Client relationship skills
  • Project Management skills
  • Advanced presentation skills
  • Leadership and People Management skills
  • Compliance
  • Can solve complex issues and will raise highly complex issues to higher level
  • Ability to influence and negotiate
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.
Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation.

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $100,000-$140,000 USDper year.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (Washington State only )
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k).

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills

  • Customer-oriented team player with good communication abilities, fostering effective collaboration and teamwork

Você será responsável por gerar novas oportunidades com ICPs estratégicos, conduzir o processo de discovery, apresentar a solução, gerenciar stakeholders e fechar negócios que gerem valor real para os clientes.

Essa posição combina estratégia e operação, exigindo boa capacidade de aprendizado e uma visão holística de ponta a ponta sobre o negócio, alinhada às nossas iniciativas de GTM para que sejam sistematizadas, cíclicas e voltadas para aprendizado contínuo.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você será responsável por liderar o ciclo completo de aquisição de clientes — do mapeamento e prospecção ao fechamento — com ownership sobre cada etapa e contribuição direta na construção da nossa máquina de crescimento.

  1. Liderar o ciclo completo de vendas outbound: da geração de leads até o fechamento.

  8. Trazer feedbacks estruturados dos clientes e cadências para aprendermos e evoluirmos.

• Liderar o ciclo completo de vendas outbound, da geração de oportunidades à conversão, com foco em ICPs estratégicos e contas complexas.

• Desenhar e iterar jornadas comerciais multicanal, personalizando cadências, mensagens e abordagens com base em dados e sinais de engajamento.

• Operar e integrar ferramentas de GTM (Apollo, Clay, AI SDR, HubSpot), garantindo a execução e otimização de campanhas outbound.

• Analisar dados de conversão e performance, extraindo insights acionáveis para refinar discursos, copy, canais e priorização de contas.

• Conduzir testes e experimentos comerciais, com foco em previsibilidade de receita, eficiência operacional e redução de CAC.

• Colaborar com fundadores, produto e tech para alinhar o processo comercial à estratégia de GTM e escalar as abordagens que funcionam.

Hard skills:

  • Experiência em vendas B2B consultivas (mínimo 2 anos), preferencialmente em SaaS ou tech.
  • Domínio do processo outbound: mapeamento de contas, cadências multicanal, cold outreach e qualificação.

  • Conhecimento em ABM e estratégias de priorização baseadas em sinais de compra, para estruturar abordagens mais inteligentes e personalizadas.

Soft skills:

  • Capacidade de colaboração multifuncional com equipes de produto, vendas e tecnologia.
  • Comunicação clara e estratégica — traduz conceitos complexos em ações simples.
  • Mentalidade orientada a testes, aprendizado e otimização contínua.
  • Alta capacidade de autogestão e priorização de múltiplas frentes simultâneas.
  • Perfil mão na massa, com orientação à solução e foco em entrega de valor.
  • Adaptabilidade para lidar e crescer em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Disposição para se comprometer com a cultura da empresa e a crescer conosco.
  • Nível de inglês suficiente para leitura e compreensão de textos acadêmicos e artigos.
  • Cabeça de dono e busca por criar relacionamentos de longo prazo.

description:
Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.


Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.


Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;

Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Segmento Posterior ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.


Additional information

  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação CLT
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:
CURSO PARA o concurso de JUIZ FEDERAL (TRF - 5ª REGIÃO)

RETA FINAL - JUIZ FEDERAL (TRF - 5ª REGIÃO)

O Reta Final para Juiz Federal do TRF-5 conta com um Cronograma de Leitura da Lei Seca que busca tratar dos principais diplomas legais exigidos no concurso, com base no Edital de 2025.

O curso é coordenado pelos professores Fábio Roque Araújo (ex-Juiz Federal e Registrador de Imóveis) e Alexandre Piovesan (Juiz do Trabalho), contando com materiais nos seguintes formatos:

  • Artigos dos Códigos e Leis em PDF
  • Questões da Lei Seca, disponíveis em nosso Vade Mecum de Questões
  • Centenas de Mapas Mentais

Metodologia: nossa intenção é que, em um primeiro momento, seja feita a leitura da legislação através dos Flash Cards disponibilizados. Feito isso, passaremos para a realização das questões em nossa plataforma. Por fim, os Mapas Mentais buscarão enfatizar os pontos de maior cobrança, que podem ser exigidos no concurso.

Qual é o tempo necessário para ler os materiais? O Cronograma disponibilizado demandará, no mínimo, 2 horas por dia para a execução das metas diárias, que incluem:

  • Leitura dos Flash Cards

  • Experience with performance profiling, optimization techniques, and software algorithms.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

  • Experience with back-end testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Mocha).
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms and deployment processes (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
  • Familiarity with message queuing systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka).
  • Knowledge of caching strategies and technologies (e.g., Redis, Memcached).
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., CI/CD, monitoring, logging).

description:
The Business Unit Leader leads their team towards success in creating sustainable people, profit, and planet value, by adopting the following roles:

1. Member of the Operations team

The Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. They are actively involved in:

  1. Sharing best practices between Business Units and contributing to Plant performance in a collaborative manner, maintaining a "ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM" mindset.
  2. Detecting and developing talents to grow their careers in the Shop, exporting talent to support business needs.
  3. Supporting Shop decisions even under uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances.
  4. Improving Business Unit performance through coaching and feedback.
  5. Providing input on support team members' performance and development recommendations.

2. People developer

The Business Unit Leader is passionate about developing people, viewing their plant as a platform for recruitment, training, and professional growth. They are expected to:

  1. Promote a lifelong learning mindset by evaluating competencies and identifying development opportunities.
  2. Ensure development through Spoke training and social promotion projects.
  3. Utilize accessible career paths for all employees.
  4. Build and believe in diverse teams.
  5. Support competency development via mentoring and coaching.

3. Representative/Role model of Company values, purpose & strategy

The Business Unit Leader embodies the group's values and represents the Plant to employees by:

  1. Living out values and inspiring through behavior.
  2. Motivating teams using Michelin purpose & Dream.
  3. Ensuring understanding of the Plant strategy and individual roles in collective success.
  4. Aligning the shop vision and engaging teams to realize it.
  5. Addressing employee issues timely and ensuring accurate attendance records.
  6. Developing Safety as a core value, ensuring responsibility for safety among employees.

4. Customer & business partner

The Business Unit Leader understands customer needs and guides teams to be customer-centric. They are expected to:

  1. Understand customer requirements and their role in meeting expectations.
  2. Focus on all aspects of economic value creation.
  3. Support business through collaboration on industrialization, digitalization, and industry transformations.

5. Environment promoter

The Business Unit Leader promotes sustainability and environmental impact reduction by:

  1. Fostering a culture valuing sustainability and environment.
  2. Implementing strategies for environmental impact and biodiversity.

CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE

6. ICARE & Empowerment role model

Leading with the ICARE leadership model, inspiring and coaching teams to progress by:

  1. Inspiring passion for ICARE at all levels.
  2. Creating inclusive, safe, collaborative, and intelligent team environments.
  3. Fostering empowerment and engagement in plant evolution and transformation.

7. Operational Excellence Leader

Developing operational excellence by ensuring:

  1. Activities apply MMW practices, creating sustainable foundations for performance.
  2. Continuous progress through variation and non-value tasks reduction.
  3. Achievement of SMQDC performance levels and standards compliance.
  4. Team empowerment, increased autonomy, and responsibility.
  5. Effective problem-solving to eliminate root causes.

TECH AREA of EXCELLENCE

8. Digital and Innovation contributor

Driving innovation, engineering, and technology transformation by:

  1. Encouraging digital application use and data-driven approaches.
  2. Building foundations for transformation (data quality, skills, organization, roadmap).
  3. Supporting projects that develop capabilities aligned with Michelin strategy, promoting digital best practices.

Job Description
O Hub Digital faz parte da nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia, tendo papel de destaque na nossa transformação em uma empresa media tech e D2C. Aqui cuidamos da gestão de dados e do desenvolvimento dos nossos produtos digitais como Globoplay, Globo.com, família G (G1, Ge, Gshow) e Cartola, visando a melhor experiência de consumo, interação e relacionamento com os nossos usuários.
Sobre a área
O time de Digital Analytics faz parte da estrutura de Data&AI e atua como um pilar estratégico para a avaliação da performance dos produtos digitais da Globo, como Globoplay, Cartola, GE, G1, entre outros. Nosso trabalho possibilita o entendimento do comportamento dos usuários e o impacto das iniciativas de negócio, fornecendo insumos valiosos para tomada de decisão e avaliação da efetividade das estratégias da empresa. Somos responsáveis por garantir a qualidade, governança e acessibilidade dos dados digitais, assegurando que a coleta esteja bem estruturada, confiável e alinhada aos objetivos de negócio.
Diversidade:
Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsibilities and assignments
Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar a definição e a manutenção do framework de eventos (Ex: GA4, GTM, Amplitude), promovendo reuso e padronização na coleta de dados entre produtos e squads;
  • Garantir a governança da implementação de eventos, taxonomias, documentação e versionamento;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com stakeholders das áreas de produto, marketing, tecnologia e dados, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em estratégias de mensuração consistentes;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e promovendo padronização entre os times de produto;
  • Apoiar a integração de ferramentas de mensuração com plataformas de dados e marketing, promovendo interoperabilidade e consistência nas entregas;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias e recorrentes com foco em comportamento do usuário, eficiência de funcionalidades e identificação de oportunidades;
  • Fomentar a cultura orientada a dados, promovendo boas práticas, capacitação técnica e troca de conhecimento entre os profissionais alocados em diferentes frentes.

Requirements And Qualifications
Do que você precisa:
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de mensuração digital, como Google Analytics 4 e Google Tag Manager;
  • Vivência na implementação e manutenção de estruturas de eventos e tags em ambientes com múltiplos produtos ou squads;
  • Domínio de SQL e experiência com análise de grandes volumes de dados em BigQuery ou tecnologias similares;
  • Conhecimento em processos de governança e documentação de dados (eventos, taxonomia, tracking plan);
  • Perfil colaborativo, com capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e fomentar boas práticas entre diferentes times;
  • Organização e disciplina para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas simultaneamente, mantendo visibilidade e consistência nas entregas.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de mensuração digital - Amplitude;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker, Looker Studio (Data Studio) ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados, pipelines e integrações com plataformas de marketing;
  • Noções de JavaScript, debugging de eventos e ferramentas de inspeção (DevTools, Tag Assistant);
  • Experiência em atuação em estruturas de plataforma ou áreas de competência (chapter, center of excellence);
  • Vivência com governança de eventos, taxonomias e documentação técnica em escala;
  • Experiência com criação de frameworks reutilizáveis de coleta e análise de dados.

• Familiaridade com frameworks de governança comoISO/IEC 19770 , ITIL ou CSDM .
• Domínio de Excel, ferramentas de relatórios e integrações com CMDB/ERP.

He/she will focus on structured tasks associated with proactive response, initial identification and remediation of suspicious network and host based activity. Conduct Tier 1 SOC activities to collect, store, and correlate, analyze, identify and respond to security data derived from sensors.
Implement, configure, and optimize the detection and reporting capabilities of company’s global security tool suite.
Collect and analyze intrusion artifacts (e.g., event logs, source code, malware) and use discovered data to support incident response actions.
Conduct rapid incident response activities and cyber event investigations.
Conduct a level of critical thinking as it relates to root cause analysis of actual or suspected security incidents recommended corrective actions.
Provide and or contribute to the development of ad-hoc information security reports to be shared with the Information Security Working Group and other executive leadership, as required

Associate or Bachelor’s degree of Science in computer science, information systems, engineering, or programming

Advanced understanding and demonstrated technical skils and abilities in the technical information security operations domain

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Sênior
description:
Somos uma empresa em expansão no mercado Tech. Buscamos evoluir, incluir, crescer, sonhar e aplaudir junto com as nossas pessoas. Queremos que você se sinta muito mais que número e resultados e, se quiser fazer parte de um time que tem como objetivo transformar as relações de carreira e vida pessoal, seu lugar é aqui.

Engenheiro de Dados Sênior

Procuramos um profissional com expertise em ferramentas gerenciadas do Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e sólida compreensão de DataOps e SRE para integrar nosso time de dados. O papel envolve construir, otimizar e garantir a confiabilidade de pipelines de dados, utilizando BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform, Composer e outras ferramentas do GCP. É essencial ter forte capacidade analítica, de resolução de problemas, com foco em automação, inovação e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades

  1. Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis no GCP, com foco em ferramentas como BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform e Composer.
  2. Desenvolver arquiteturas de dados modernas no GCP, incluindo datalakes e data warehouses, usando Cloud Storage, Dataproc e Data Catalog.
  3. Orquestrar pipelines complexos com Composer, aproveitando o Apache Airflow.
  4. Realizar ETL de dados de diversas fontes, utilizando Dataflow e outras ferramentas de integração do GCP.
  5. Modelar e transformar dados no BigQuery, usando SQL e recursos avançados como UDFs.
  6. Garantir a qualidade dos dados com processos de validação e limpeza usando Dataform e outras ferramentas.
  7. Otimizar desempenho e custos das soluções de dados, monitorando e ajustando pipelines.
  8. Criar e manter documentação técnica atualizada sobre arquitetura e pipelines.
  9. Colaborar com engenheiros, cientistas de dados e analistas para soluções integradas.
  10. Implementar pipelines seguindo os princípios de DataOps, com foco em automação, CI/CD.
  11. Aplicar práticas de SRE para garantir confiabilidade, disponibilidade e escalabilidade, monitorando incidentes.
  12. Desenvolver ferramentas para automação de tarefas operacionais, como monitoramento e recuperação de falhas.
  13. Manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias em engenharia de dados, DataOps e SRE no ecossistema GCP.
  14. Participar na construção de uma cultura data-driven na empresa, promovendo uso eficiente dos dados.

Detalhes adicionais

Oportunidade híbrida, com 3 dias presenciais na Avenida Paulista, São Paulo - SP.

Benefícios na Maitha

  • Programa de pontos e premiações;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de carreira;
  • EDI: experiência de desenvolvimento individual com suporte de especialistas em desenvolvimento humano.

description:

Atuamos com consultoria, gestão e comercialização de energia, sempre com foco em simplificar o mercado com entrega de resultados e impacto positivo.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um time colaborativo, diverso e apaixonado pelo que faz. Valorizamos a autonomia, o aprendizado contínuo e a construção conjunta de soluções que geram valor real para o mercado e para a sociedade.

• Excelência: A excelência é a nossa marca registrada. Acreditamos que cada detalhe importa e que sempre é possível fazer melhor. Buscamos o extraordinário em cada entrega, com qualidade, precisão e orgulho do que colocamos no mundo.

• Inovação: Somos movidos pela vontade de criar o novo. Encaramos desafios com curiosidade, criatividade e coragem para propor soluções que transformam. Pensamos diferente porque queremos resultados diferentes — e melhores.

• Proatividade: Aqui, a gente faz acontecer. Antecipamos necessidades, agimos com agilidade e assumimos o protagonismo. A proatividade é o que nos impulsiona a ir além, transformar cenários e gerar impacto.

• Foco em resultados: Nosso olhar está sempre voltado para a entrega de valor. Trabalhamos com propósito, metas claras e senso de urgência. Para nós, resultados consistentes são o reflexo de um time comprometido e alinhado com o que realmente importa.

• Dedicação: Nos envolvemos de verdade com o que fazemos. Colocamos energia, cuidado e paixão em cada projeto. A dedicação nos aproxima dos nossos clientes, fortalece nossos laços e impulsiona conquistas coletivas.

• Colaboração: Acreditamos que o sucesso é construído em equipe. Valorizamos a troca, o respeito e a escuta. Juntos, unimos forças, talentos e ideias para criar soluções mais completas, humanas e potentes.

Na Simple, você fará parte de uma equipe que acredita na força do marketing para impulsionar o crescimento e a presença da marca no mercado. Sua contribuição será essencial para alcançar nossos objetivos estratégicos! Aqui, você vai:

Você liderará a equipe de marketing garantindo a implementação eficaz das estratégias, gerenciará o orçamento e executará o planejamento estratégico da área. Além disso, será fundamental para manter um excelente relacionamento com as áreas internas, promovendo a fluidez de conteúdo e ideias que suportem as iniciativas de marketing. Sua função incluirá a condução da estratégia de conteúdo para campanhas, planejamento da captação de leads em conjunto com a área comercial e monitoramento da jornada de conversão de clientes, propondo melhorias sempre que necessário.

• Liderar e conduzir análises em Google Analytics, SEO e cruzamentos com resultados de CRM para aumentar a geração de leads;

• Realizar pesquisas de mercado , visando o atingimento dos resultados estratégicos (branding, awareness e growth);

• Monitorar e direcionar as atividades da(s) agência(s) e parceiros externos visando otimização dos resultados;

• Realizar análises de performance de indicadores de marca e acompanhar os KPIs da equipe;

• Estratégias para a expansão dos serviços dentro da carteira de clientes (cross e upselling ).


Requirements and skills

Buscamos profissionais que sejam apaixonados por marketing e tenham uma visão estratégica para promover o crescimento da marca. Se você é um executor nato, com experiência em gestão de marketing e foco em resultados, esta pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você brilhar conosco!

Para isso, é importante que você tenha:

• Graduação superior completa em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração ou áreas correlatas;

• Necessária Pós-graduação ou MBA na área de Marketing ou Negócio s;

• Conhecimento em SEO, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Ads e ferramentas afins;

Além das competências técnicas, procuramos habilidades comportamentais que alinhem com nossa missão:

O profissional deverá garantir a máxima disponibilidade dos equipamentos e a otimização dos processos produtivos. Job Description:

Principais atividades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, visando a otimização da vida útil dos equipamentos e a redução de paradas não programadas.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho de manutenção (KPIs) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Gerenciar o backlog de manutenção, priorizando atividades com base na criticidade e impacto na produção.
  • Elaborar e controlar o orçamento da área de manutenção, buscando a eficiência e a redução de custos operacionais.
  • Coordenar a execução das atividades de manutenção, garantindo a conformidade com as normas de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente.
  • Promover a capacitação e o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe de manutenção.
  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de gestão de manutenção.
  • Gerenciar o estoque de peças, componentes e materiais de manutenção, garantindo a disponibilidade e o controle de inventário.
  • Otimizar os níveis de estoque, evitando excessos e rupturas que possam impactar a produção.
  • Liderar e participar de projetos de melhoria contínua, modernização de equipamentos e expansão de infraestrutura.
  • Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, custos e especificações técnicas.

Our organisation:

Trouw Nutrition is the global leader in innovative feed specialties, premixes and nutritional services for the animal nutrition industry. Trouw Nutrition provides species-specific nutritional solutions consisting of feed concepts, products and nutritional know-how. Trouw Nutrition's nutrition solutions have met the need of farmers and home-mixers, feed producers, integrators and distributors. Trouw Nutrition has locations in 25 countries and around 5000 employees. Our mission is Feeding the Future.

description:

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company, operating over 260data centers across the globe. Digital leaders harness Equinix's trusted platform to bring together and interconnect foundational infrastructure at software speed. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, speed the launch of digital services, deliver world-class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting their sustainability goals.

A career at Equinix means you will collaborate on work that impacts the world and be surrounded by endless opportunities to learn new skills and grow in varied directions.We embrace diversity in thought and contribution and are committed to providingan equitable work environment that is foundational to our core values as a company and is vital to our success.

As a Process Mining in Automation team for Managed Solution, you will be instrumental in analyzing, optimizing, and designing business processes using data-driven insights.   • Support the automation of processes by identifying suitable candidates for automation and working closely with the automation team

  • Monitor and measure the impact of process improvements and automation initiatives

  • Prepare and present findings, reports, and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels of the organization

  • Conduct regular follow-ups with teams to assess the performance of implemented processes and make necessary adjustments

  • Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in process mining, automation, and business process management

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in process mining, business process analysis, or related fields

  • Proficiency in process mining tools (e.g., Celonis , UiPath Process Mining, etc.)

  • Good understanding of the Managed Solution business as well as the portfolio of products and solutions used to support platforms and services

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

  • Familiarity with automation technologies and methodologies (e.g., RPA, BPM) is well considered

  • Knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL) is an advantage
